8153.description: The courser wears the mightiest antlers in the known lands.  Such antlers are used to defend the courser, goring an attacker and often damaging the points.  Perfect, natural antlers are the sign of an animal spirit with supreme confidence.$b$bTo hold such antlers will bestow the same confidence in you.$b$bHunt the mosshoof courser, find the perfect antlers and bring them to me.
8153.objectivesText: Bring a pair of Perfect Courser Antlers to Ogtinc in Azshara.  Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast of the Ruins of Eldarath.
8153.title: Courser Antlers

8182.description: $n, our worst fears have come.  Legend speaks of the Soulflayer ruling the ancient troll world through evil and terror, and his power was absolute.  If he cannot be stopped now, then his new reign may spread across all of Azeroth!$B$BThere is a contingent of Zandalarian trolls who may help us stem this tide of darkness.  They have camped on Yojamba Isle, off the coast of Stranglethorn, west of the ruins of Zul'Kunda.  Speak with their leader, Molthor, and pray he knows how to defeat Hakkar.
8182.title: The Hand of Rastakhan

8231.description: The wavethrasher is an amphibious beast living only here in Azshara.  They are powerful and resilient.$b$bThe tough, reflective scales from a wavethrasher mirror the strength of the hunter.$b$bTrack and hunt wavethrashers along the coast of Azshara, and bring me their scales.
8231.objectivesText: Bring 6 Wavethrasher Scales to Ogtinc in Azshara.  Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
8231.title: Wavethrashing

8234.description: First things first.  What I've lost is a small blue bag, the contents of which are a private matter.$b$bDon't bother going after the thieves, because they are already dead.  What we do know is the fools couldn't get the bag open. so they sold it to some timbermaw shaman in Azshara as a holy relic.  Clever.$b$bI need you to travel to Azshara and retrieve it from the shaman through subtlety... or force.  Better luck with the first method, I'd wager.  Once acquired, take it to Archmage Xylem.
8234.objectivesText: Retrieve the Sealed Azure Bag from the Timbermaw Shaman in Azshara.  Then take the bag to Archmage Xylem, also found in Azshara.
8234.title: Sealed Azure Bag

8235.description: Lord Ravenholdt has asked a favor of us both.  He wishes to remove the enchantment from this bag.$b$bUnfortunately, some of my books on the subject of dispelling were taken recently, only to be destroyed by savages.  The remains of my books are still valuable to me.$b$bIf you can bring me enough of the encoded fragments, I can piece them back together.  Your best chance is to kill forest oozes, since they have a tendency to pick up just about anything.  You'll find them in northeast Azshara.
8235.objectivesText: Bring 10 Encoded Fragments to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.
8235.title: Encoded Fragments

8251.description: The blood elves in Azshara have developed a method for pulverizing the magical items they acquire.  This glittering dust they produce differs from the components normally acquired by a disenchantment spell.$b$bWhen I sent my apprentice to trade for the dust, he was killed without hesitation.  For that, they must pay.$b$bThe time for talk is over, $n.  Find the blood elves along the cliffs of Azshara and use more "persuasive" methods to acquire their glittering dust.
8251.objectivesText: Bring 10 Glittering Dust to Archmage Xylem.
8251.title: Magic Dust

8252.description: Take a look around you.  The ruins and beaches are overrun with spitelash.  Recently, the wretched creatures have learned to recognize the rare components indigenous to Azshara.$b$bSpecifically, I speak of enchanted coral -- they are drawn to it by reasons unknown to me.  Now there is little coral left in the bay, and it is vital to my research.  I need you to separate some enchanted coral from the spitelash sirens and bring it to me.
8252.objectivesText: Collect 6 Enchanted Coral and return them to Archmage Xylem.
8252.title: The Siren's Coral

8253.description: There is a green drake deep in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar by the name of Morphaz.$b$bYears ago, he overwhelmed me in a bold ambush and consumed my apprentice whole.  While the loss of an apprentice is not unknown to me, this particular one carried an arcane shard of unsurpassed size and quality.$b$bYou must gather powerful allies and delve into the temple.  Destroy Morphaz and recover the arcane shard from his ageless stomach.
8253.objectivesText: Retrieve the Arcane Shard from Morphaz and return to Archmage Xylem.
8253.title: Destroy Morphaz

8255.description: The mosshoof coursers of Azshara are magnificent animals who once lived in Felwood.  They naturally resist disease and poison, and were unaffected by the corruption there.  In their ancestral wisdom, they simply chose to leave that sickened place.$b$bIt saddens my heart, but I must ask you to hunt these mighty beasts for me.  Gather four courser glands as the first ingredient for a restorative salve -- a salve we will use to heal Felwood.
8255.objectivesText: Acquire 4 Healthy Courser Glands and bring them to Ogtinc in Azshara.  Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
8255.title: Of Coursers We Know

8256.description: For this restorative salve, you must use a simple formula: one part poison, two parts cure.  You have acquired one cure, now you must gather the poison.$b$bPowerful undead, such as the lingering highborne who wander the Ruins of Eldarath, are sometimes so infused with evil that it coalesces into a sickly greenish goo.  To the living, this substance is known as ichor of undeath.$b$bDue to the potency of this vile element, I require only a single ichor.
8256.objectivesText: Acquire an Ichor of Undeath for Ogtinc in Azshara.  Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
8256.title: The Ichor of Undeath

8257.description: Now the last part, the second cure.$b$bThe green drake Morphaz is known to be immune to all forms of poison and disease -- many druids died to bring us this information.  There is no doubt his blood is potent for our needs.$b$bA courier from the Cenarion Circle will take the parts you have already collected while you gather the last.  Summon your allies and seek out the drake's lair in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar.  Bring his blood to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.
8257.objectivesText: Kill Morphaz in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar, and return his blood to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.  The entrance to the sunken temple can be found in the Swamp of Sorrows.
8257.title: Blood of Morphaz

8277.description: Beetix Ficklespragg at your service!  My cousin Noggle makes a living gathering rare herbs for Cenarion Hold alchemists.  Or used to, anyway.  He came back from his last trip with a strong poison running though his veins.$B$BI've managed to slow down the venom, but to fully neutralize it I need poison samples from whatever stung him.$B$BNoggle arrived from the north, so I'd bet my shirt stonelash scorpids or sand skitterers did it.  Bring me some stingers and fangs and I'll try to make an antidote for him.
8277.objectivesText: Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 8 Stonelash Scorpid Stingers and 8 Sand Skitterer Fangs. Return to her when you have completed the task.
8277.title: Deadly Desert Venom

8279.description: The Twilight's Hammer are not kind to those that leave their ranks.  They hunt me to this day like I'm some sort of beast!  Needless to say, an enemy of theirs is a friend of mine!$B$BTo decipher this Tablet I'll need the book used by their scribes to encode secret messages: the Twilight Lexicon.  It's such an important tool that they keep its three chapters in different locations!  The officers entrusted with the Lexicon are known as Twilight Keepers, look for them at the Twilight's Hammer camps.
8279.objectivesText: Bring the three chapters of the Twilight Lexicon to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.
8279.title: The Twilight Lexicon

8280.description: Cenarion Hold is a location of utmost strategic importance.  I'm convinced that while we hold it our victory over the silithid is guaranteed.  Provided our influx supplies can be maintained, that is.$B$BDesert worms have proven to be more of a threat to our supply caravans than even the silithid themselves.  Just this morning, a large shipment of morrowgrain was ravaged by a group of dredge strikers.  I need you to thin their numbers to ensure our supplies aren't jeopardized.
8280.objectivesText: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to kill 15 Dredge Strikers.
8280.title: Securing the Supply Lines

8281.description: Your performance has been truly exemplary so far, $n.  Our supply lines are not completely safe yet, however.  In the absence of dredge strikers, their larger southern cousins will surely move in to take their place in the north.$B$BYou'll have to kill quite a few dredge crushers to keep them at bay, but we cannot leave the safety of our supply lines to chance.
8281.objectivesText: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to slay 20 Dredge Crushers.
8281.title: Stepping Up Security

8284.description: A camp of Twilight's Hammer cultists once thrived northwest of here.  If you were to venture there now, you'd find the area swarming with elementals and nothing but scattered pieces of wood and canvas to mark the spot where the camp was.$B$BI've recovered a few fragments of a clay tablet from the site, but I have too few of them to piece together anything useful.  See if you can find the remaining tablet fragments so we can shed some light into the Twilight's Hammer presence here in Silithus.
8284.objectivesText: Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to collect 8 Twilight Tablet Fragments.
8284.title: The Twilight Mystery

8285.description: There are rumors of a Twilight's Hammer member called Ortell having deserted his sect.  Word has it he hid in the mountains south of Southwind Village, where he lives as a hermit.  Perhaps you can enlist his help in deciphering the tablet.$B$BTake the restored tablet with you and seek out Ortell.
8285.objectivesText: Take the restored tablet to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.
8285.title: The Deserter

8304.description: My dear Natalia has gone missing.$B$BTruth be told, she had been acting strangely for weeks leading up to her disappearance. I had caught her talking to herself when no one was around on more than one occasion. She was adamant that everything was ok and that she must be allowed to continue her research.$B$BShe was last seen heading to Bronzebeard's camp to the south.$B$BMy soldiers are spread too thin, $n. I need you to go to Bronzebeard's camp and question those dwarves.
8304.objectivesText: Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to question the inhabitants of Bronzebeard's Encampment. You will find Bronzebeard's Encampment south of Cenarion Hold.$B$BOnce you have gathered the requested information, return to Commander Mar'alith.
8304.title: Dearest Natalia

8309.description: After our initial foray into the hives and Mistress Mar'alith's subsequent madness the three hives have been spewing out bugs! The increased activity might be tied into the glyphs covering those strange crystals.$B$BWe must get a rubbing from crystals in all three hives. If we can get those rubbings, we might be able to make sense of this madness.$B$BTake this transcription set and some buddies and hit those hives, $n. Don't come back until you've gotten copies from each hive.
8309.objectivesText: Rutgar Glyphshaper at Bronzebeard's Encampment in Silithus wants you to venture to Hive'Ashi, Hive'Zora, and Hive'Regal and recover Glyphed Rubbings from the Glyphed Crystals of each hive.$B$BUse the Geologist's Transcription Kit to make a reasonable facsimile of the ancient glyphs. Return to Rutgar Glyphshaper when you complete this task.
8309.title: Glyph Chasing

8310.description: I think I can formulate an elixir that will allow us to more readily decipher the glyphs and language of the silithid and Qiraji! What do I need? Glad you asked! I need brains! More specifically, a brain from each silithid type that inhabit the hives. Bring me brains and Rutgar's work might not be for naught.
8310.objectivesText: Frankal Stonebridge at Bronzebeard's Encampment in Silithus wants you to recover a Hive'Zora Silithid Brain, Hive'Ashi Silithid Brain, and a Hive'Regal Silithid Brain. Return to Frankal when you have completed this task.
8310.title: Breaking the Code

8318.description: Some of the Twilight's Hammer cultists carry around little papers with gibberish written on them.  I want you to bring me a stack of them, $c.$B$BI can't figure out what the gibberish means, but that's not the point!  These papers are how their different groups communicate secretly.  The more texts we take out of circulation, the less they can communicate!
8318.objectivesText: Bring 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
8318.title: Secret Communication

8323.description: Now that I have the Twilight Lexicon in my possession, there is a small favor I'd like to ask of you.$B$BMy former organization has a secret encoded bulletin they circulate on a monthly basis.$B$BIf they make any progress searching for me or if they call off the search, word will be published on the True Believer.$B$BAlthough this information is obviously valuable to me, the publication contains other useful information that I can share.  Bring me any encoded texts you find on Twilight's Hammer members.
8323.objectivesText: Hermit Ortell wants you to bring him 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts
8323.title: True Believers

8367.description: Serving the Horde in one of the great battles against the Alliance is a source of great honor!  The few however, that have served the Horde in ALL of our active battlefronts are our truly great fighters.  We shall vanquish our opponents, not by fighting isolated skirmishes, but by waging a well-coordinated war.$B$BGo forth and crush the Alliance in Arathi Basin, Alterac Valley and Warsong Gulch!  For Honor!  For the Horde!
8367.objectivesText: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor, 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor, 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor, and 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
8367.title: For Great Honor

8368.description: The battle in Warsong Gulch against the Silverwing Sentinels is of great importance.  Under the guise of protecting a forest that doesn't belong to them, the Alliance seeks to deny the Horde one of our largest sources for lumber.$B$BDo not let this happen, $n!  Come back to me with proof of serving the Horde in a worthy manner!
8368.objectivesText: Bring 3 Warsong Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
8368.title: Battle of Warsong Gulch

8369.description: Listen up, $n.  No matter what you might have heard about the battle raging in Alterac Valley, one thing remains true: the Stormpike Expedition invaded Frostwolf Territory.  The day we allow the Alliance to invade Horde lands without a forceful response is the day I hang up my axe and live the rest of my life in shame.  Go forth and expel the invaders!
8369.objectivesText: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
8369.title: Invaders of Alterac Valley

8370.description: Our conflict with the Alliance has escalated to a true war.  No longer are false pretenses to enter into battle used or expected by either side at this point.$B$BThe battle for the Arathi Basin is one of resources, plain and simple.  Either the Alliance gets the resources and uses them against us or we get them and use them to keep our war efforts going.  Help the Defilers maintain the flow of resources we need, $n!
8370.objectivesText: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
8370.title: Conquering Arathi Basin

8371.description: We're not fighting isolated battles against the Horde anymore, $g lad:lass;.$B$BVictory in one front means denying the Horde resources they'd use against us in a different battle.  By the same token, losing any given battle could give the advantage to our opponent somewhere else around the world.$B$BThe Alliance is in need of more combatants with this sort of worldly understanding... truly seasoned veterans!  $n, come back to me after you've served against the Horde at all of our active battlegrounds.
8371.objectivesText: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor, 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor, 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor, and 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
8371.title: Concerted Efforts

8375.description: Make no mistake about it, $n.  The Horde is quite right when they say Alterac Valley is Frostwolf Territory.$B$BYou see, the Stormpike Expedition arrived as peaceful visitors to the area in search of ore and relics.  The Frostwolves reacted with the most brutal and uncivilized act of aggression the Alliance has experienced.$B$BLet us never forget the brave dwarves that perished in that cowardly unannounced attack.  Go now, $c, do your part in the battle for Alterac Valley.  For the Alliance!
8375.objectivesText: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
8375.title: Remember Alterac Valley!

8395.description: Winning a war is about more than just outsmarting and outfighting your opponent.  Victory often comes down to simply producing more than your enemy.$B$BWhat we have in Arathi Basin is a sizeable supply of resources for whichever side manages to claim it first.$B$BIf the Alliance comes out victorious, it'll mean more swords and pikes for our troops.  If the Horde were to win, those swords and pikes would still get made, they'd just be pointed at us!  Now is the time to help the Alliance in Arathi Basin, $n.
8395.objectivesText: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
8395.title: Claiming Arathi Basin

8396.description: Winning a war is about more than just outsmarting and outfighting your opponent.  Victory often comes down to simply producing more than your enemy.$B$BWhat we have in Arathi Basin is a sizeable supply of resources for whichever side manages to claim it first.$B$BIf the Alliance comes out victorious, it'll mean more swords and pikes for our troops.  If the Horde were to win, those swords and pikes would still get made, they'd just be pointed at us!  Now is the time to help the Alliance in Arathi Basin, $n.
8396.objectivesText: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
8396.title: Claiming Arathi Basin

8402.description: The Silverwing Sentinels are at war with the Warsong Outriders due to the destruction the Orcs are causing to the forest.  There are, however, more reasons to defend this particular forest than plain love for nature.$B$BThe forest forms a strategic barrier that makes Ashenvale defendable against a large-scale attack.  Without it, Astranaar would last a day or two before being annexed to the Barrens.$B$BDo your part in fighting the Warsong Outriders, $n!  For the Alliance!
8402.objectivesText: Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
8402.title: Fight for Warsong Gulch

8403.description: The Silverwing Sentinels are at war with the Warsong Outriders due to the destruction the Orcs are causing to the forest.  There are, however, more reasons to defend this particular forest than plain love for nature.$B$BThe forest forms a strategic barrier that makes Ashenvale defendable against a large-scale attack.  Without it, Astranaar would last a day or two before being annexed to the Barrens.$B$BDo your part in fighting the Warsong Outriders, $n!  For the Alliance!
8403.objectivesText: Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
8403.title: Fight for Warsong Gulch

8410.description: Bath'rah the Windwatcher has sent out a summons for a shaman of your wisdom.  He requests you bring a sample of each of the elements to show you are ready.$b$bTo find Bath'rah, go to the river east of Tarren Mill.  Follow the river north until you come across the ruins where Bath'rah resides.
8410.objectivesText: Collect a sample of air, fire, earth and water for Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
8410.title: Elemental Mastery

8411.description: Welcome, mon.  You bring me the elements and then we do the talkin'.
8411.objectivesText: Bring the elements earth, air, fire and water to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
8411.title: Mastering the Elements

8412.description: The elemental spirits of this place don't be likin' me any more.$b$bYou know about the totems more than any, and I be needin' a spirit totem to protect me.  We already got the elements, now we need somethin' more with more nature.  More primal.$b$bIn the Western Plaguelands you can kill bears for claws and spiders for their eyes.  The carrion birds eat everything, so they might have either one.
8412.objectivesText: Bring the pieces for the spirit totem to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
8412.title: Spirit Totem

8414.description: Greetings, $c.  Crusaders like you are a welcome sight in these desolate reaches.$b$bYour holy strength is needed to help fight the endless undead here.  We need you to collect a large number of scourgestones and bring them to High Priest Thel'danis.  The high priest can be found guarding Uther's Tomb in Sorrow Hill, not far from here.$b$bOnly one with an Argent Dawn Commission can hope to find scourgestones, so speak to Officer Pureheart if you haven't already.
8414.objectivesText: Collect 20 Minion's Scourgestones and bring them to High Priest Thel'danis in the Western Plaguelands.
8414.title: Dispelling Evil

8419.description: $n, an imp in Felwood by the name of Impsy has requested your presence.  It is somewhat strange, as he has asked that you bring a piece of felcloth as a sign of good faith.  Considering the power you already wield as a warlock, I can only assume you know the satyrs of Felwood carry this felcloth.$b$bYou can find Impsy just north of the Bloodvenom Falls, which I've heard is quite lovely this time of year.
8419.objectivesText: Bring a piece of felcloth to Impsy in Felwood.
8419.title: An Imp's Request

8420.description: Maybe this sounds strange coming from an imp, but I'd like a pet of my own.  I really would.  It's just not fair that Niby gets me and I get nothing!$b$bIn fact, it doesn't even need to be a living pet.  I'd need something to start making it with, like some felcloth.  The satyrs here in Felwood sometimes have felcloth, so you'd just have to kill enough of them until you find some.  That doesn't sound so bad, does it?
8420.objectivesText: Bring a piece of felcloth to Impsy in Felwood.
8420.title: Hot and Itchy

8421.description: Now that I have my felcloth, I can really begin making *my* pet.$b$bIt's going to need some eyes though.  Perhaps you could rip some rotting wood from the irontree folk for me, so I can carve out some lovely eyes.  They're up north in the Irontree Woods.$b$bI'll also need some bloodvenom essence to give it that new demon smell.  The tainted oozes carry the essence, and they hang out right here near Niby and me.
8421.objectivesText: Bring 10 Rotting Wood and 4 Bloodvenom Essence to Impsy in Felwood.
8421.title: The Wrong Stuff

8423.description: <The Hero looks you over.>$b$bYou are a $c, no doubt.  I would ask an honorable task of you, but I must test your strength.$b$bIt is said that Rexxar would measure the sharpness of his blades by killing a helboar with a single, swift strike.  Now I will measure your strength by killing them.
8423.objectivesText: Kill 7 Helboar in the Blasted Lands and return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
8423.title: Warrior Kinship

8424.description: The continued presence of the shadowsworn in the Blasted Lands bring great pain to me.  Their dark rituals and spells cause agony unlike any I felt while alive.$b$bThrough you I can deliver my own message of pain.  Go forth and deliver my wrath.
8424.objectivesText: Slaughter the Shadowsworn in the Blasted Lands and return to the Fallen Hero of the Horde.
8424.title: War on the Shadowsworn

8429.description: The battle in Warsong Gulch against the Silverwing Sentinels is of great importance.  Under the guise of protecting a forest that doesn't belong to them, the Alliance seeks to deny the Horde one of our largest sources for lumber.$B$BDo not let this happen, $n!  Come back to me with proof of serving the Horde in a worthy manner!
8429.objectivesText: Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
8429.title: Battle of Warsong Gulch

8430.description: The battle in Warsong Gulch against the Silverwing Sentinels is of great importance.  Under the guise of protecting a forest that doesn't belong to them, the Alliance seeks to deny the Horde one of our largest sources for lumber.$B$BDo not let this happen, $n!  Come back to me with proof of serving the Horde in a worthy manner!
8430.objectivesText: Bring 3 Warsong Gulch Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
8430.title: Battle of Warsong Gulch

8438.description: Our conflict with the Alliance has escalated to a true war.  No longer are false pretenses to enter into battle used or expected by either side at this point.$B$BThe battle for the Arathi Basin is one of resources, plain and simple.  Either the Alliance gets the resources and uses them against us or we get them and use them to keep our war efforts going.  Help the Defilers maintain the flow of resources we need, $n!
8438.objectivesText: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
8438.title: Conquering Arathi Basin

8439.description: Our conflict with the Alliance has escalated to a true war.  No longer are false pretenses to enter into battle used or expected by either side at this point.$B$BThe battle for the Arathi Basin is one of resources, plain and simple.  Either the Alliance gets the resources and uses them against us or we get them and use them to keep our war efforts going.  Help the Defilers maintain the flow of resources we need, $n!
8439.objectivesText: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
8439.title: Conquering Arathi Basin

8446.description: Corruption seeps from this object.$B$BThere may be a link between this object and the dragons coming forth from the Dream. You must find someone that can decipher the meaning of this item. Perhaps the druids of the Moonglade or Cenarion Hold could assist you further.
8446.objectivesText: Find someone capable of deciphering the meaning behind the Nightmare Engulfed Object.$B$BPerhaps a druid of great power could assist you.
8446.title: Shrouded in Nightmare

8551.description: I used to sail a ship from here all the way to Ratchet, in Kalimdor.  I was a successful captain with a sterling reputation.$B$BUntil...$B$BThose cursed sea giants ruined me!  They smashed my ship, killed my crew, and set me on a lifeboat to Booty Bay.  And one of the giants, Gorlash, stole my Captain's Chest.  He said he wanted it for a snuffbox.  The nerve!$B$BI hear Gorlash wanders the coast east of here.  Find him and get back my chest!  Do that, and you'll have earned a captain's gratitude.
8551.objectivesText: Bring Smotts' Chest to Hecklebury Smotts in Booty Bay.
8551.title: The Captain's Chest

8922.description: I must find a way to speak with Anthion Harmon... or more specifically, his ghost!$B$BI know of an engineer with a queer interest in the supernatural.  He claims he can build a machine that allows him to speak with the dead!$B$BThe blood you collected was intended for him; travel to Gadgetzan and bring it to him as payment for his services!
8922.objectivesText: Bring the Sealed Blood Container to Mux Manascrambler inside Gadgetzan in Tanaris.
8922.title: A Supernatural Device

8923.description: You must be quite brave to have stuck around after that.  That or I've piqued your interest with the piece of armor I gave you.  There is more from where that came from, if you're still interested in aiding me.$B$BThe venom samples you collected are for an acquaintance of mine, Mux Manascrambler, an engineer with an interest in the supernatural.  His latest project consists of a device that allows you to communicate with the dead!  My last hope is to contact Anthion and find out more about my situation.
8923.objectivesText: Take the Sealed Venom Container to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan.
8923.title: A Supernatural Device

9051.description: The toxin you helped me create is for a special purpose.  The great devilsaurs of the crater make it dangerous to hunt and difficult for me to survive.  Even if I possessed the necessary strength, killing a devilsaur simply allows another to move into its territory.$b$bTake this poisoned barb and stab it deep into a living devilsaur.  The toxin should pacify the creature, though I do not know how quickly...
9051.objectivesText: Stab a Devilsaur with the Devilsaur Barb. Return to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater when you have completed this task.
9051.title: Toxic Test

9053.description: It is as I feared -- the toxin is simply too weak for such a powerful creature.$b$bIf we are to create a toxin of high enough potency, you must venture to the bottom of the Temple of Atal'Hakkar, unlock the secrets of the altar and recover a putrid vine from the guardian there.  The temple is dangerous, and it would behoove you to bring friends.$b$bReturn to me when this is done.
9053.objectivesText: Retrieve a Putrid Vine from the guardian at the bottom of the Sunken Temple and return to Torwa Pathfinder.
9053.title: A Better Ingredient

9364.description: My research has revealed a unique purpose for the prismatic shell.$b$bCarry the shell and cast your polymorph spell on the Spitelash in Azshara.  If you wait a few moments, the chaotic aura of the shell will cause them to split into several smaller clones for a few moments.  Kill these clones as quickly as possible, and the shell will collect their essence.$b$bWhen the shell is full, return it to me.
9364.objectivesText: Polymorph the Spitelash of Azshara and kill the clones that appear several seconds later.  When you have slain 50 Polymorph Clones, return to Archmage Xylem in Azshara.
9364.title: Fragmented Magic

9556.description: You've no doubt been fighting long and hard among the towers, $r. We would like to give something back to you in return for your defense of these lands, but first, you must prove to us you understand the weight of the tragedies that took place here.$b$bWalk the streets of Stratholme and find a vial of the holy water. Once you have it, travel to the mage quarter of Stormwind or the Undercity... There, if you are victorious within these lands, you will find my colleague.
9556.objectivesText: Collect a bottle of Stratholme Holy Water from within the city of Stratholme and deliver it to the Lordaeron Mage within the Mage Quarter of Stormwind or the Undercity when your side is victorious in the Eastern Plaguelands.
9556.title: To The Victor...

9665.description: Agents of the Forsaken uncovered an Alliance plot to establish new bases here in the Eastern Plaguelands, at abandoned towers throughout the area.$b$bIt is imperative that we not allow them to establish a significant presence on our eastern borders, and so we must stave off this Alliance incursion. Our current plans are to drive them out of any towers they may have already seized, and occupy those that we have under our control against further attacks.
9665.objectivesText: Capture Crown Guard Tower, Eastwall Tower, Northpass Tower and Plaguewood Tower in the Eastern Plaguelands, then return to Emmisary Gormok at Light's Hope Chapel.
9665.title: Bolstering Our Defenses

65610.description:
I met Krilge while making Mooncloth in Ashenvale. He was stationed there to protect civilians from danger, until he disappeared...

They've stopped looking for him and consider him a deserter, but I don't believe it.

We would often meet at Fallen Sky Lake before it became overrun by those aggressive bog beasts.

I'm not typically one to ask favors, but if you could go to Ashenvale and look for any sign of him, I'd appreciate it.
65610.objectivesText: Investigate Fallen Sky Lake in Ashenvale and report your findings to Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
65610.title: Wish You Were Here

79007.description:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79007.objectivesText: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.
79007.title: ... and that note you found

79008.description:
<The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire.

Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.>

"Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
79008.objectivesText: Charred remains of the note serve as your only guide.
79008.title: ... and that note you found

79192.description: The note begins, "Mission said they were both making deliveries for New Plague. Looks like simple apothecary accidents to me. Find my cozy spot in the mountains between The Barrens and Desolace if you want a safe place to talk."
79192.objectivesText: You tear the note from the plank and read the scrawled writing.
79192.title: Stepping Stones

79229.description:
The campsite before you is a grisly scene. Judging by the remains, the victims were two humans and a dwarf. Markings on the bones indicate a savage attack, but the looted supplies tell you this wasn't done by an animal. The wounds don't match centaur weaponry either.

Perhaps an experienced scavenger of these lands would know what to make of this.
79229.objectivesText: Find someone in Desolace who knows about the pillaged campsite.
79229.title: Highway Robbery

79235.description:
I've found a couple of scenes like you describe, $n. Always camps of humans and dwarves. Rumor among the caravans is a group of Horde marauders did it. Seems likely given the victims, and how brutal the attacks were.

Apparently the bandits fled Desolace once an Alliance marshal got hot on their trail.

If you're looking to track one of 'em down, I'd check Booty Bay. Ports always have shady characters coming and going. You might catch one trying to get a boat to somewhere.
79235.objectivesText: Find one of the Desolace marauders.
79235.title: On the Lam

79236.description:
You with the marshal? No, you don't look like it.

The rumors you've heard are only half true. Yes, we were pillaging human and dwarven camps, but we weren't doing it for the Horde. We were privately employed.

I'll tell you the whole story if you buy me some grog.
79236.objectivesText: Bring a Cherry Grog to Tokal, in Booty Bay, to hear the rest of her story.
79236.title: Cherry for Your Thoughts?

79242.description:
As I was saying...

Our boss wasn't with the Horde. She was a night elf named Illari Duskfeather. She gave us intel on the camps, and even let us keep most of the loot. She only kept a few of the rarer finds.

Once the marshal was on our tail, though, she left us for dead. I don't know her motives, but I think we were set up as patsies.

I'm not the vengeful type, but I won't stop someone else from hunting her down. If you're looking for her, she once mentioned a hideout on the coast of Arathi.
79242.objectivesText: Find Illari Duskfeather on the coast of Arathi Highlands, and get access to her cache of stolen loot.
79242.title: No Honor Among Thieves

79358.description:
Floodin' the Thousand Needles is no small feat, $n. If I hadn't felt the elements' outrage meself, I'd have never believed it. But here we are.

The quilboar aren't the first tae weaponize the elements irresponsibly, and they won't be the last. If we want to prepare our own counter-ritual, we'll need a better understanding of these twisted elements. Take this book. It details the many denizens of Azeroth and how they practice shamanism.

If you can learn from them, maybe we can find a solution.
79358.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Twisted Fire Totems, $2oa Twisted Earth Totems, $3oa Twisted Air Totems, and $4oa Twisted Water Totems for Veyric Thunderhame in Arathi Highlands.
79358.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire

79360.completionText: Bring the Tattered Note to Rau Cliffrunner in Thousand Needles.
79360.description:
Now that you have mastered the elements, you have an obligation to them, and thus to all of Azeroth herself. We call to them for aid, we do not demand their power. It is time you return the favors granted to you. And I think I know how.

The quilboar twist the elements for their own ends, and seem to be extending their reach within these borders. Go into their kraul and put an end to whatever they scheme. These lands must be protected.
79360.objectivesText: Defeat Charlga Razorflank in Razorfen Kraul and collect information on the quilboar's plans.
79360.title: Elemental Aid

79361.description:
So the quilboar mean to flood the Thousand Needles with their twisted shamanism, do they? It seems almost unimaginable, but you yourself have seen that these creatures are not to be taken lightly.

I had wished to continue your training in earnest, but there is no time for that now. These lands are home to many different creatures, friend and foe alike, and none of them deserve such a fate. We must act.

Take this tome. It was meant for study, but may now hold the key to dispersing this coming storm.
79361.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Twisted Fire Totems, $2oa Twisted Earth Totems, $3oa Twisted Air Totems, and $4oa Twisted Water Totems for Prate Cloudseer in Thousand Needles.
79361.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire

79366.completionText: Return to Rau Cliffrunner in Freewind Post and report what happened.
79366.description:
Now that you have the twisted totems, we must wield them to summon forth the corrupted elementals the quilboar are calling upon. Defeat them to cleanse these lands and put an end to the Razormane's abominable ritual then report back to Rau Cliffrunner with your success.

You should begin your clensing at the steam pools to the west. That area is rich with each of the elements. But be careful, $n. The quilboar will not sit idly while you interrupt their plans.
79366.objectivesText: Use the Twisted Totems to put an end to the quilboar ritual.
79366.title: Heed My Call

79442.description: Our people cannot thank you enough, but I have no real use for this eye. I have heard of an old shaman in the Alterac mountains that has an eye for storm elemental magic. Perhaps he may be able to craft something for you.
79442.objectivesText: Deliver the Eye of the Tempest to Bath'rah the Windwatcher in Alterac Mountains.
79442.title: The Tempest's Weapons

79624.description:
The recipe appears to be for some sort of meat dish. It is written in a language you don't understand. Ogre is your best guess, given the source and subject matter.

Ogres aren't usually culinary types but, if you knew one with such an inclination, they could translate the recipe for you.
79624.objectivesText: Find an ogre who can read the Illegible Recipe.
79624.title: Anyone Can Cook

79677.description:
Other ogres laugh at Skonk because Skonk smaller than them. They say small ogre weak, so Skonk learn to cook instead of fight. This only cause more teasing, so Skonk run away to follow dream.

Skonk can make dish, but need ingredients. You take note. Find ingredients. Skonk more focused on craft; not really logistics guy.
79677.objectivesText: Gather the ingredients for Skonk's dish, then bring them to him in Arathi Highlands
79677.title: A Quick Grocery Run

80411.description:
From the most recent letter we intercepted, it appears the final artifact Caius desires is the Talisman of Kazdor. The letter states this talisman is somewhere inside Zul'Farrak. 

I want you to complete the job as per Caius' instructions, as not to arouse his suspicion. This means you'll have to go into Zul'Farrak alone, as usual.  

However, before you deliver the Talisman, bring it back here. We'll be giving Caius a little more than he asked for.
80411.objectivesText: Find The Talisman of Kazdor inside of Zul'Farrak. Then, bring it to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor. You must complete the job alone.
80411.title: The Talisman of Kazdor

81764.description:
Well met again, $n. Shaw and his spies have provided us with information on a mysterious merchant who just arrived in Kalimdor and is looking to offload a collection of dangerous artifacts. We've come to believe that he has an Echoing Orb in his collection. He is staying at the Theramore Inn in Dustwallow Marsh. Travel quickly, retrieve the orb, and speak to no one of this. We are sending you in alone to avoid drawing the attention of our enemies. 

Be safe, and go with the light.

objectives.text: Travel to Theramore and find the mysterious merchant.

81764.objectivesText: Travel to Theramore and find the mysterious merchant.
81764.title: The Mysterious Merchant

81765.description: <The Paladin standing before you is not known to you. Speak with him to determine what he knows of the merchant and the current situation.>

objectives.text: Speak with Elrick and learn more

81765.objectivesText: Speak with Elrick to learn more.
81765.title: Elrick, Paladin of the Silver Hand

81766.description:
<You find a missive on the body of the "paladin". It is covered in blood and difficult to read, but you can make out the message on the parchment.

It's clear upon reading the note that this entire venture to find the "merchant" was a trap. You should return to Katherine for further instructions.>

objectives.text: Bring the Bloody Missive to Katherine the Pure

81766.objectivesText: Bring the missive to Katherine the Pure at the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind.
81766.title: The Bloody Missive

81790.description:
Each of the Echoing Orbs is attuned to a different aspect of its master. The method you used in Ashenvale to destroy the Althalaxx Orb will not be effective on the orb we possess. I know of a ritual that may be able to destabilize the orb and allow us to destroy it, but it requires components with specific magical significance. We already possess some of the required materials, but you'll need to retrieve the rest. 

Take this, it should help you in your search.
81790.objectivesText: Use the hints in Gregory's Note to determine where to find the magical components needed for the ritual. You will need help from allies for this.
81790.title: Materials of Significance

81917.description:
I have seen this creature you call "Calefactus" many times in my field studies. By all accounts, it appears to be a nigh-invulnerable core hound made from Fel energies.

However, if what you say is true, and the Twilight's Hammer were planning to enslave it, then there may be a way to subdue the beast.

The Shadowsworn, to the south-east, are known to perform dark rituals, including the enslavement of Fel creatures. Perhaps members of their order carry a clue to weakening Calefactus?
81917.objectivesText: Bring 5 infernal chain links to Bloodmage Lynnore in the Blasted Lands
81917.title: Chains That Bind

82068.description: Complete a Nightmare Incursion mission in Feralas or Hinterlands today and you'll earn an extra reward.

objectives.text: Complete a Nightmare Incursion Mission in Hinterlands or Feralas

82068.objectivesText: Complete a Nightmare Incursion mission in Feralas or Hinterlands and then report to Field Captain Korlian or Field Captain Arunnel.
82068.title: Fight the Nightmare Incursions

83934.description: Heya! You look like the "resourceful adventurer" type so maybe you can help me out. See, my brothers and I came from Kezan looking to start up a new business venture but we ran afoul of some pirates who stole our startup money. The people who are funding our operation back home aren't exactly what I'd call understanding, so we'd make it worth your while if are able to find any of the coin and return it. It's no ordinary gold but you should know it when you see it.
83934.objectivesText: Bring a Tarnished Undermine Real to Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay.
83934.title: Show Me the Money!

84318.description:
Oi! $c! Yes, ye! Ye did me a solid by smashing up that depressin' mess of a meatsuit I've been riding in all these years, but I dinnae feel much of a pull to move on. I'm expectin' it's because I got some "Unfinished Business" to get up to 'afore I can be on me way. Well dull-wit, ye just been conscripted to help!

I need ye to fetch me hammer. Should be somewhere in Corrin's Crossing and it'll be hard to miss. 

Oi, take this too. It's me favorite gold tooth. Give it a rub when you've found me weapon.
84318.objectivesText: Find Orthas' missing hammer in Corrin's Crossing.
84318.title: Oi!

84319.description:
Great job with the hammer, $c. Next up is me armor. Definitely need that back to move on to the great beyond.

Only problem is it's in the eh... innards o' one of them abominations. I know, I know, it's askin' a lot, but ye gotta understand I was once a mighty thane under the mountain! I simply can't move on knowin' that the ancestral armor of me clan is dissolving in the gutjuice of a giant rotting mountain o' meat!
84319.objectivesText: Orthas needs you to recover his missing armor from the corpse of an Abomination somewhere in Plaguewood.
84319.title: Oh No Ye Don't!

84330.description:
So ye see, we need to find a suitable Dwarf corpse and do a bit o' ritual to em' to get my spirit grounded so I can be sent on me way! All perfectly normal stuff, o' course! We'll also need a bit o' Necrotic Runestone from a necromancer type, of course. There's one in Stratholme that goes by Maleki the Pallid. Can't expect he'll be too willin' to part with it willingly but there's a solve for that!

Get me that stone and then head to the undercroft. There's a corpse there that'll do!
84330.objectivesText: Obtain a Necrotic Runestone from Maleki the Pallid in Stratholme, then find the Rotting Dwarf Corpse near the Undercroft in southwestern Eastern Plaguelands.
84330.title: A Wee Bit O' Necromancy

86577.description:
The corruption that rains down from Hyjal flows through the mountain's waters and seeps into everything here in the wood. The creatures that drink the water take the corruption into themselves. It makes them ferocious, diseased, and fearless.

To counter these effects, I must understand them, and to do that I need samples from the afflicted.

A few samples of putrescent organs from the wolves and bears should do. Take your time; the creatures are common here in Felwood.
86577.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Putrescent Bear Organs and $2oa Putrescent Wolf Organs to Kelek Skykeeper.
86577.title: A Sampling of Putrescence

86616.description:
As a shaman, one of the challenges of communing with the elements is that there are other shaman with opposing agendas. The elements do not care why we do what we do, they just do as we ask!

The trolls at Jintha'alor also practice the shamanic arts, and their interruptions and attacks are a constant thorn to us here.

Find their Vilebranch totems and bring them back to me so that I can nullify their powers. Some they carry, some they place as wards around their altar.
86616.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Vilebranch Totems back to Maret Firetend.
86616.title: Repurposed Totems

86620.description:
Though we have a good line of gryphons here, there are always a few egg clutches in the wild that are in danger of not making it. A gryphon parent can lose a fight against a wolf, or fall sick. Without help, the fledglings will never survive.

Fortunately, we have the means to raise and protect lost young ones like this. If you find lost eggs in the wild, bring them to me.
86620.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Lost Gryphon Eggs for Gryphon Master Talonaxe.
86620.title: Fledgling Rescue

86746.description:
My people are struggling, $n. 

The Legashi satyr have invaded our den, corrupting many of the Blackmaw and separating us from our Timbermaw allies. Those of us who survive their attacks are huddled in makeshift camps. Worse still, the satyr's corruption is spreading across the land, and poses a threat to my already vulnerable tribe.

The Legashi lurk among the ruins northeast of here. I must ask you for help in defeating them.
86746.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Legashi Satyr, $2oa Legashi Rogues, and $3oa Legashi Hellcallers for Ekkal at the Ruins of Eldarth.
86746.title: The Legashi Threat

86784.description:
My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."

If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.
86784.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Dry Branches and bring them to Eleanor Shackleton.
86784.title: Sticks and Bones

86792.description:
The satyr within the Legashi stronghold are even more fearsome than those of the outer camps. When our party was discovered, we found ourselves overwhelmed.

One of us was slain, and another captured. I was the only one able to successfully retreat. I cannot return to Rageroar with my head hung in shame, but I cannot fight the Legashi alone, either.

I ask you, then, to assist me in weakening the satyr's forces. Go into their stronghold and slay them.
86792.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Legashi Hellraisers, $2oa Legashi Soulstealers, and $3oa Legashi Blackguards for Korsa outside Legashi Stronghold.
86792.title: Thinning Their Forces

86796.areaDescription: Help Graal break out of Legashi Stronghold
86796.description:
You there, $r!

These fiends ambushed my scouting party, and have taken me captive. I don't know what plans they have for me, but I don't intend to find out. I must escape and return to Ursolan; no doubt Korsa is worried about me.

While I would love to break out of this cage and leave a trail of satyr corpses in my wake, I'm afraid I'm slightly outnumbered.

Perhaps you share my hatred for the fiends, and would help me escape?
86796.objectivesText: Help Graal break out of Legashi Stronghold, then inform Korsa outside Legashi Stronghold.
86796.title: Later, Satyr

86804.description:
Furze is not the first with his affliction. Since the Legashi's attacks against us began, many Blackmaw have presented with a similar illness. Each one eventually fell to corruption, becoming mindless and destructive.

I have been working towards a cure. My studies indicate that one could possibly be made by transmuting the Legashi's own firewater, but I cannot acquire it myself.

You might find firewater, or a way to brew it, in the Legashi camps to the east. You would be a great help in doing so.
86804.objectivesText: Find a way to get Legashi Firewater in the Legashi Encampment.
86804.title: An Unlikely Source

86925.description:
It appears this cauldron could be used to brew the firewater that Elder Bramblesnap is after.

If only you knew how. Surely, one of the satyr in the Legashi Encampment must carry a recipe.
86925.objectivesText: Find a Legashi Firewater Recipe from satyr in the Legashi Encampment.
86925.title: Toil and Trouble

86926.description:
The recipe reads:

Harvest ye the sprout of hell
bushel o' five will serve ye well
mixed with mote of demon's power
shall usher in their final hour
86926.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Satyrweed and a Fel Mote to the Legashi Cauldron in the Legashi Encampment.
86926.title: Felfire Burn, Cauldron Bubble

87295.description:
You may have seen the Redstone basilisks wandering the wastes outside while you were on your way to Nethergarde Keep. They're tough creatures, well adapted to survival in the Blasted Lands. One of their key qualities is their sturdy scales, which reflect heat, protect against sand and wind, and even deflect weapon blows!

They're a perfect material for making shields, and if you can bring me a bundle, I'll compensate you well. Only bring ones in good condition!
87295.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Redstone Basilisk Scales to Bernie Heisten.
87295.title: Deflective Surface

87346.description:
When the Legashi overran the Blackmaw, the rest of the Timbermaw sealed their passage to the hold to keep out the satyr. We had no idea they lived on as refugees.

I would gladly aid my brethren, but we are fighting our own battles. Like the Legashi threaten the Blackmaw, the Deadwood do likewise to us. We haven't many warriors to spare.

The Deadwood chieftain, Bloodmaw, is in Felpaw Village to the south. Eliminating him would greatly ease our struggle. Bring me his mace, and you will have our aid.
87346.objectivesText: Kill Chieftain Bloodmaw and bring his mace to Gorn One Eye in Timbermaw Hold.
87346.title: Chieftain Bloodmaw

87492.description:
You may have seen some of the unusual crystal growths that dot this crater. I'm not a miner, but these growths don't seem to fit with the kinds of soil deposits all around here.

I believe I caught sight of a damaged crystal not far from here while I was foraging. I wonder if it holds any secrets about the origins of these strange formations? If you happen to spot it, I would love to investigate a sample piece.
87492.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Damaged Blue Crystal back to Torwa Pathfinder.
87492.title: Uncanny Crystal

88807.description:
Azshara may appear beautiful, but it is a cursed place. There are horrors deep beneath its waters, waiting to emerge and tear the world asunder.

All we can do for now is fight the horrors that have already surfaced.

The Spitelash Naga occupy the Ruins of Eldarath to the north east. The ones within the ruins are well-fortified, so we must pick off the weaker ones along the outskirts first.

As you can see, we could always use another fighter here, if you are up to the task.
88807.objectivesText: Kill 8 Spitelash Warriors and 8 Spitelash Screamers for Commander Truesong in Azshara.
88807.title: Slay the Spitelash

88809.description:
Millennia ago, Eldarath was a sight to behold; a living testament to the glory and might of the Kaldorei. What we call Eldarath today is hardly a pile of rubble by comparison.

Nonetheless, what remains is worth salvaging, if only to preserve our history. The Spitelash must be driven out before Eldarath is completely ransacked.

Following the road north east will lead you right into the heart of the ruins. Go there, and retrieve as many of our relics as you can--and their commander's head.
88809.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Eldarath Relics from Spitelash Serpent Guards, Spitelash Sirens, and Spitelash Myrmidons, and Lord Sarthiss' Head for Commander Truesong in Azshara.
88809.title: Preserving Eldarath

88812.description:
I fear time may soon forget the Kaldorei house of Ravencrest. A lone, crumbling, monument is the only surviving proof of their presence here.

The monument can be found atop the cliffs at the very tip of the southern peninsula. Spitelash enchantresses there have a set of power stones which they use to channel their magic. Take this ward, and nullify them. This will cripple the Spitelash's magic, and give us an upper hand in driving them out.

While you're at it, be sure to take out a few naga yourself.
88812.objectivesText: Kill 5 Spitelash Battlemasters, 5 Spitelash Enchantresses, and nullify the 3 Naga Power Stones near Ravencrest Monument for Commander Truesong in Azshara.
88812.title: Reclaiming Ravencrest

88884.description:
Just south of here, along the beach, there are some tablets of highborne writing. They document the highborne's investigations into the laws and powers of the arcane. 

The tablets are being kept in pagoda-like structures, guarded by naga, so I wouldn't dare attempt to procure them myself.

Fortunately, I've found myself a new assistant! 

So, what do you say? Think you could be of further use in the pursuit of knowledge?
88884.objectivesText: Find the three highborne tablets among the ruins of Southridge Beach, then bring them to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.
88884.title: Highborne Tablets

88917.description:
I came here in search of highborne artifacts. You could call me an archaeologist of sorts.

The ruins of Eldarath to the west hold many of them, although the naga are looting the ruins as we speak.

A naga called Lady Sesspira leads the pillaging; no doubt keeping the best finds for herself. 

If my research is correct, I believe she may be in possession of the staff of Archmage Selwyn, a fallen highborne mage.

I need your help to get that staff, $r. Scholars like me are ill-suited for combat.
88917.objectivesText: Find the Staff of Archmage Selwyn among the Ruins of Eldarath, and bring it to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.
88917.title: Slithering Looters

89001.description:
Greetings traveller!

If yer lookin' for a place to hang yer hat, look no further than Berdun's travel lodge! The tent's in a bit o' disrepair right now, but that can be remedied.

Tell ye what. If ye get me what I need to fix the tent, I'll let ye stay here for free. How's that sound?

I'll need some mosshoof hides. The easiest to hunt mosshooves are just north o' here, but the hide of any mooshoof will do.
89001.objectivesText: Bring 5 Mosshoof Hides to Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point in Azshara.
89001.title: Home on the Range

89038.description:
It is said that Queen Azshara once bestowed a gift upon the kaldorei of House Ravencrest; an emblem of great beauty and magical power. This mark was given as recognition of the Ravencrests' unwavering loyalty to the queen. 

The mark was last seen near the Ravencrest Monument, atop the cliffs of the southern peninsula. Securing such a relic would be the discovery of a lifetime.

As always, the ruins of the monument are crawling with Spitelash, but I trust you're rather adept at handling them by now.
89038.objectivesText: Search for the Mark of the Queen among the ruins of the Ravencrest Monument, and bring it to Saria Fairmoon in Azshara.
89038.title: A Monumental Task

89228.description:
Any travel lodge worth its salt's gotta have somethin' to eat.

Squid are in season, and ye can fish 'em up from the coasts here in Azshara. Never was much of an angler myself, but I'm a mean cook!

What do ye say? Feelin' some seafood?

If ye aren't much for fishin', try makin' friends with one! Or pay 'em for their goods and buy some.
89228.objectivesText: Fish up 10 Winter Squid for Berdun Cliffbrew at Talrendis Point, in Azshara.
89228.title: Winter Frontier Fishery

90647.description:
With all of the ingredients you assembled I was able infuse the staff you recovered with a new magic. You should now be able to bring this to bear to counteract the magic of the Wild Gods that Ve'han has so brazenly stolen.

We will need to test it, however. Bring this to the druid known as Tiala Whitemane at the Summit of Eternity. She may be able to help.
90647.objectivesText: Bring the Staff of the Mountain to Tiala Whitemane at the Summit of Eternity.
90647.title: The Staff of the Mountain

90702.description:
<Someone, or something, has rummaged through the dirt, leaving fragments of bone scattered about. An oddly shaped indentation leads deeper into the cold, wet dirt.

Something within the area may have caused the disruption.>
90702.objectivesText: Search the area for the grave's missing contents.
90702.title: Disturbed Grave

90789.description: There isn't much time, $n!  My scrying spells have revealed a powerful source of magic.  I cannot leave the tower, and would ask you to kill the vile creature in possession of this artifact.$b$bThe beast is known as Scalebeard, hiding in a cave among the Bay of Storms. Burn him to ashes and take the prismatic shell from his den.
90789.objectivesText: Retrieve the Prismatic Shell for Archmage Xylem.  The Archmage resides in a tower atop the cliffs of Azshara.
90789.title: Scalebeard

90865.description:
Just north of here lies the ruins of battles past. A dwindling scourge presence remains.

Though the mindless undead are a threat themselves, the watchers maintain a vigilant eye on those entering the area, making removal of the scourge threat even more difficult.

Remove the threat by taking from these watchers that which they value most.
90865.title: Eyes of the Watchers

91488.description:
During our last skirmish with the blood elves, my tent was badly damaged. For three nights, I have been at the mercy of the elements.

It can be repaired with a few mosshoof hides, but a lack of sleep has left me unable to hunt them myself.

The easiest mosshooves to hunt are west and south of here, but the hide of any mooshoof will do.
91488.objectivesText: Bring 5 Mosshoof Hides to Kurll at Valormok in Azshara.
91488.title: Home on the Range

91497.description:
<The seal of the first crystal bears the mark of a sword. Its energy must be channeled by an expert warrior.

The seal of the middle crystal bears the mark of a glaive. Its energy must be channeled by one of both martial and magical prowess.

The seal of the last crystal bears the mark of a talon. Its energy must be channeled by one at home in the wilds.

It's likely that some of Rimtori's officers are carrying these seals to aid her in the spell. Taking them would no doubt be troublesome for her.>
91497.objectivesText: Bring the Seal of the Warden, Seal of the Warrior, and Seal of the Ranger to the Sin'dorei Tome of Summoning.
91497.title: Seals of the Sin'dorei

91500.description:
<Seeing how the energies of the crystals are attuned to the seals, you reason that destroying a seal, thereby releasing its energy all at once, could cause its crystal to do the same.

The explosive results would certainly draw Rimtori's ire. It would also present the perfect opportunity to attack her while she's flustered.>
91500.objectivesText: Break the Seals of the Sin'dorei, then bring Magus Rimtori's head to Ag'tor Bloodfist in Valormok.
91500.title: An Explosive Gambit

91568.description:
What the beaches here lack in looks, they make up for in value!

Most of the ruins here have been picked clean, but there's some serious loot under that sand. Problem is, it's all scattered, and the naga make a long search a bit impractical. So, what's a girl to do?

Enter the Treasure Trowel 3000! The all-in-one treasure detecting shovel! A personal invention of mine.

Take this baby down to the eastern shore, and bring back whatever you find. Then, we can split the profits!
91568.objectivesText: Dig up $1oa Highborne Treasure Fragments with the Treasure Trowel 3000 for Izvi Glidfizz in Valormok.
91568.title: Long Walks on the Beach

91569.description:
Listen kid, everyone out here's scramblin' for the same thing. Belgrom, the elves, the naga, they all wanna piece 'a that ancient highborne magic.

Me? Couldn't care less, but I know a seller's market when I see one.

I've seen blood elf arcanists carrying special wands. They're used to extract magical energy from artifacts the elves find. The arcanists stay at a camp east of the elves' base camp, along the cliffs. Get me one of those wands and I'll put you on to the score of a lifetime!
91569.objectivesText: Bring a Mana-Siphoning Wand to Izvi Gildfizz at Valormok.
91569.title: Blue Gold

91698.description:
<A matriarchal furbolg speaks to you from within the cage>

"Deadwood trap me and my cub in tough cage. Key hang on Deadwood Warden belt. You hunt them, take key, lift latch, set us free. Do this, and Barkskin know your heart true."
91698.objectivesText: Recover a Deadwood Key from a Deadwood Warden and return to the Barkskin Cage.
91698.title: Barkskin Breakout

91743.description: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.
91743.objectivesText: Retrieve $1oa Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.
91743.title: Rascally Rodents

91755.description:
Have you seen those nasty tainted shrubberies wandering around this valley?

Those plants are mean, but some of them are not entirely toxic. Their leaves can have medicinal purposes.

Would you be so kind as to fetch me some Verdant Leaves? You'll have to do a little pruning, of course.
91755.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Verdant Leaves from Tainted Shrubbery in the foothills of Mount Hyjal.
91755.title: Leaves to Ligatures

91883.description:
While fighting off the Wormwing harpies I was brutally ambushed by a harpy named Zarrat who patrols this area. She snatched my spear and carried it off before I could recover. To what end she desired to possess it, I cannot say.

That spear has been in my family for generations and is of great importance to me. If you spot Zarrat among the harpies, slay her and return my spear. She is stealthy, and will not be easily found, but I would be grateful to have my spear returned.
91883.objectivesText: Slay Zarrat Wormwing and return Omnuron's Spear.
91883.title: Spear of the Skylord

92009.description:
There's something you should know about this order. There's a few inverted mana cells padded as well as I could at the bottom of the box. The cells have a tendency to discharge when they get bumped, and when not stabilized in time. It takes about two hours for the contents to fizzle.

Kaylaena will know what to do when she receives them, but I suggest going slow if you're going to ride saddled up Mount Hyjal.

If you need a refill, come back and I'll top off the canisters. Be careful, you know?

objectives.text: Shipment delivered to Mount Hyjal before it expires

92009.objectivesText: Gently transport the crate of parts and baubles to Kaylaena Springwhisper in Mount Hyjal.
92009.title: Crate Expectations

92017.description:
The flying creatures of the Summit still draw breath from the highest currents, where the corruption has not yet fully taken hold. Hippogryph feathers and chimaera hair drift through these winds, absorbing what the air remembers of an unspoiled land. I need these remnants to anchor and strengthen my purifying incense.

Gather them for me, so I may concentrate the wind's knowledge into cleansing smoke before we begin the ritual.
92017.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Grand Hippogryph Feathers and $2oa Oily Chimaera Hair for Marn.
92017.title: Cleansing Winds

92100.description:
<A spirit materializes before you, recovering from a full-body yawn.>

You have no ranks with you... and you are not dressed as a soldier. We repelled Archimonde then?

It's been so long. I had almost forgotten what I once was, but you... you must be one of the first to walk these craters in years.

<The veteran glances at his surroundings.>

Let us continue our conversation at an overlook with a view I remember vividly, just west of here. Long ago, I left my scabbard to rest there.
92100.objectivesText: Find the Veteran of the Third War's scabbard near Elderwild.
92100.title: Anywhere But Here

92101.description:
Hyjal is difficult to bear. Nightmares and murderous memories linger among the craters.

But you carry warmth from Kalimdor within you! My friend Tobin also enlisted and joined up with me, but I fear the worst for his soul. 

The Alliance company gave us steeds to break in and bond with for our upcoming deployment. We took them on a joy ride through the Barrens. Carved our names into the bottom of the Great Lift in Thousand Needles.

See if the marks remain? It will bring ease to a weary soul.
92101.objectivesText: Find the Veteran of the Third War's markings of significance on the Great Lift.
92101.title: Lifted by Legacy

92102.description:
Going so far out of your way solely for the fading wishes of a lost soul--thank you, $n. The presence of a hand contemplating the carvings, with the fragments of history that you know so far, was enough to bring me here. My presence, now, is tied to the strongest bond with the still-living.

I beat Tobin to the salt flats, and he smoked me on the raceway. 

I recall clearer now. Meet me in Mourning's Rest--the site of our last battle--next to the broken cannon near the destroyed tower on the cliff.

objectives.text: Veteran of the Third War met in Mount Hyjal

92102.objectivesText: Use the Embroidered Scabbard to meet the Veteran of the Third War in Mount Hyjal near the broken cannon in Mourning's Rest.
92102.title: Praise

92147.description:
I am one of the last of the Highfeathers, the true followers of Aviana. We respect and revere the Matron of the Skies, and we call the Druids of the Talon our allies.

The Wormwing harpies have overrun much of this plateau. They reject our protector Aviana, and seek only to despoil the lands around us.

Blood has been spilled and must be repaid. Scatter their feathers to the wind.
92147.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Wormwing harpies on Mount Hyjal and bring their feathers to Phoebe Highfeather.
92147.title: Highfeather Helper

92169.description:
The Blackthorne Pact. That's what they call themselves. Apostate druids that have taken over Hyjal Summit. Violent, and extremist. They blame Malfurion Stormrage for robbing them of their immortality, and have sworn to reclaim the power that they were forced to relinquish. I did not understand the magic that empowered them before, but it's becoming clear now.

Take the staff, use it on the Blackthorne druids around the mountain. It should respond to and dispel the wards protecting them.

objectives.text: Test the Staff of the Mountain

92169.objectivesText: Use the Staff of the Mountain on $1oa  members of the Blackthorne Pact on the Summit of Eternity to remove their wards and then kill them.
92169.title: Paying Back the Pact

92317.description:
So, the hermit druid seeks a force to balance the 'life' in this magic of his? Then the answer is death, naturally. You have come to the right place for such a thing.

No doubt you've seen the undead crawling all over my domain. They are fueled by stolen power that animates them even in death.

That stolen power is exactly what is needed in this spell you speak of. Kill the undead and search through their skulls for a coalesced Drop of Stolen Life. Return it to Ketharas once you have it.
92317.objectivesText: Acquire a Drop of Stolen Life from the Scourge in the ruins on Mount Hyjal, then return to Ketharas.
92317.title: Stolen Life

92343.description:
The burrow you speak of is a tunnel to Blackmaw Hold. In the past, the furbolg have guarded it fiercely, making it inaccessible to outsiders. With this satyr situation, however, we can get inside.

So close to Nordrassil, there would be actively growing roots. Older roots can be seen on the world's surface, but newer ones can only be found deep underground. Little is known of their magical properties.

If you were to bring me some samples to study, the druids of Thunder Bluff would be in your debt.
92343.objectivesText: Gather 10 Nordrassil Root Caps inside Blackmaw Hold for Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
92343.title: Get to the Roots of It

92344.description:
The burrow you speak of is a tunnel to Blackmaw Hold. In the past, the furbolg have guarded it fiercely, making it inaccessible to outsiders. With this satyr situation, however, we can get inside.

So close to Nordrassil, there would be actively growing roots. Older roots can be seen on the world's surface, but newer ones can only be found deep underground. Little is known of their magical properties.

If you were to bring me some samples to study, the Cenarion Circle would be in your debt.
92344.objectivesText: Gather 10 Nordrassil Root Caps inside Blackmaw Hold for Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus.
92344.title: Get to the Roots of It

92401.areaDescription: Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
92401.description:
It's my husband Edward...

He has not returned from his weekly journey to the graveyard in the Lordaeron ruins. Our son was lost when Arthas razed the city, and my dear Edward is still filled with guilt and sorrow that we never found his body. I've tried to warn him against searching those overrun ruins, but he refuses to give up. I try not to worry, but it's been days.

There are things there I cannot contend with but if you are willing, I need to know the fate of my husband.
92401.objectivesText: Investigate the disappearance of Edward Heartweaver in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
92401.title: A Frightened Request

92421.description:
As a paladin of the Forsaken, it is my duty to exact the will of our Dark Lady while tending to our people's needs. We are fortunate with an opportunity to accomplish both.

Above the Undercity, the scourge still roam unchecked in great numbers. Our forces dwindle trying to reclaim our land, and decaying flesh cannot be reknit. Not without replacements.

Would that our glorious captain Garek Bandarion still be with us, I know what he would wish. To finish what he started and heal our kin. For Lordaeron!
92421.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Intact Limbs within The Ruins of Lordaeron for Morbin Lightbane in the Undercity.
92421.title: Light's Justice

92422.description:
Reports have come in from the Lordamere Overlook deep within the Ruins of Lordaeron. An unholy fog has taken over the streets and graveyard, affording the scourge up there some measure of stealth. 

Our scouts indicate they're being conjured by a new power within their ranks, a necromancer known as Rath'mael. We do not have the luxury of waiting this one out, $n.

If you have allies, summon them and their aid to the Forsaken. Drive this creature out of our lands.
92422.objectivesText: Kill Rath'mael in the Ruins of Lordaeron for Deathguard Kristof in Brill.
92422.title: The Wrath of Rath'mael

92434.areaDescription: Find a way into Dalaran along the Lordamere Lake
92434.description:
Whatever caused Dalaran's barrier to lower has left the city in turmoil. With you having dealt with their patrols, there is no better time than now to make our way inside and discover their secrets.

Take the key you found at the internment camp and seek out their sewers along the northern border of the city. With luck, those mages had no reason to put a ward over such a... disagreeable point of entry.
92434.objectivesText: Find a way into Dalaran along the Lordamere Lake.
92434.title: Blood in the Streets

92457.description:
The breach has affected many of our factotums and enchantments throughout the city, including many that are seeing to our defenses. This fragmented arcane energy has spoken to rogue elementals who seek to saturate themselves in this free flowing magic.

While we are busy tending to the wards and other major incidents, it would be a favor to the Kirin Tor if you could cull this elemental throng.
92457.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Seeking Remnants, $2oa Saturated Remnants, and $3oa Mana Echoes inside the City of Dalaran for Archmage Modera outside of Dalaran.
92457.title: Starving Arcane

92519.description:
Apothecary Jorell was supposed to bring us a case of antidotes and elixirs days ago, but we're still empty handed. That fool has probably poisoned himself again by brewing in that poorly-ventilated shack he calls his lab.

If you want to further help our ward, you would be a far more reliable individual for this job.

Follow the road to Go'shek farm, south and a bit west of here. You'll likely find it packed and ready to go, with Jorell either missing or unconcerned with his obligations.
92519.objectivesText: Pick up a case of Packaged Tonics at Jorell's lab in Go'shek Farm and return to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall.
92519.title: Ward Restocking

92594.description:
While you're traveling around the mountain, I can't resist asking for another small favor...

Did you see all those fel shrubberies and plants littering the hills down below? It turns out they burn rather well, which is both good, and bad. Handy for feeding into a small furnace, but also a risk when it twists together and binds up gears...or bootstraps!

Thin their numbers on your way down, and I'll pick up the weeds myself once they've dried out.
92594.objectivesText: Destroy $1oa Tainted Shrubbery for Kaylaena Springwhisper at the workshop in the Tainted Foothills.
92594.title: Kindling, Kinda

92743.description:
As the strongest centaur clan in all the land, we deserve armaments with ferocity that matches our strength! 

Warug needs one most of all. A helm... no, a crown! A conqueror's crown! I heard legends of a fearsome conqueror across the seas. Go to a place they call the Badlands and seek out a crypt there. Return to me only when you have found the crown.

Do this for me, and I will reveal the Magram's greatest strength.
92743.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and return a Conqueror's Crown from the Badlands to Warug in Magram Village.
92743.title: A Conqueror's Crown

92833.description:
Ve'han now claims the Nordrassil Lodge, under the boughs of the great tree, as his lair. It is time for us to put this magic to the ultimate test.

Take the staff and bring it to bear against Ve'han. Dispel the magic protecting him and bring him to justice!
92833.objectivesText: Use the Staff of the Mountain to strip Ve'han Talongrasp of his stolen power, then destroy him.
92833.title: Ve'han's Fall

92960.description:
A lingering demon presence remains to the east. Among them are the hellish beasts responsible for ravaging our kin, siphoning their power to use it against our allies.

Penetrate their camp, locate these beasts and slay them. Retrieve any samples that remain.

Perhaps there is something we can learn from these efforts.
92960.objectivesText: Retrieve $1oa Ephemeral Essences for Elaena Moonwhisper.
92960.title: Siphoned Ephemeral Essence

93034.description:
One of our scouts returned to the village while you were away, with news that confirmed my fears.

The Magram are up to something, $n. It is not good.

The Valley of Bones far to the east is a cursed land that few centaur dared to enter and fewer still ever return home. Our enemy has found something there, something evil, and we need to learn what it is.

Seek out the scout Nerlokh at the southern entrance, but you may have to prove yourself further to the Gelkis.
93034.objectivesText: Improve your reputation with the Gelkis, and locate Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones far east of Gelkis Village.
93034.title: Valley of Bones

93035.description:
You need not peer far to see the undead shambling about ahead of us, but have you noticed something unusual about them?

They walk on two legs, not four! These skeletons are not even our fallen kin. The Magram must be defiling the bodies of those who died long before the Desolace was our domain. I cannot imagine how they justified turning their backs on Mother Theradras and took to desecrating corpses that have rested here for centuries.

Put the undead to rest, $n.
93035.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan and slay $1oa Undead Ravagers, then return to Nerlokh at the southern entrance to Valley of Bones.
93035.title: Ravaging Ravagers

93037.description:
While I waited for your arrival, I peered a bit further between the arches and noticed something I need you to confirm for me.
