I cannot bear saying it aloud. Not until my suspicions have been proven true.

$n, while you are getting your bearings in the valley, slay some of the necromancers that look weaker than the others. Tear off their ritual garb, carefully, and bring it to me. I must know whether I am of clear mind and vision.
93037.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring $1oa Necromantic Garb to Nerlokh at the entrance of the Valley of Bones.
93037.title: Outing Outcasts

93041.description:
This discovery is devastating for our clan, but it is in our best interest to keep this only to those who need to know. Uthek is one such person who needs to be aware of what is going on here. I suspect she will know how to proceed.

Take this to show her. For good measure, we should also bring evidence of the necromancy itself to her. Find a skull that looks recently cursed. I suspect they may be hoarding them in the maws of one of the goliath's skeletons.
93041.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis Clan, and bring an Accursed Skull and Gelkis Necromantic Garb to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.
93041.title: Facing the Truth

93128.description:
As much as I would like Uthek or Khan Shaka to give the order, I fear our window of opportunity is short. Too short to consult those at Gelkis Village.

I believe with the situation unfolding here at the Valley of Bones that the Magram have left Khan Jehn with minimal defenses. If there was ever a time to attack another clan's Khan, it is now.

But $n, a Khan is not to be trifled with, least of all Jehn. If you are brave enough to make your move, you must be swift but do not underestimate him.
93128.objectivesText: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and slay Khan Jhen at Magram Village. Once you have succeeded, report to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village in Desolace.
93128.title: Khan Jehn

93163.description: Built and destroyed again; the heart of Iodax the Obliterator rests in your hands. The golem was likely an invention of the dark iron dwarves, or of something before them. As such, the dwarves at Thorium Point may be interested in your discovery here.
93163.objectivesText: Bring the Heart of the Obliterator to Thorium Point.
93163.title: Heart of the Obliterator

93176.description:
Admiring my little menagerie, are you? They are my un-life's work. I've spent countless hours studying them: their anatomy, their diets, even their social rituals.

Do you wish to join me in the hobby? Here, take this package. The notes and materials contained within should get you started. If you lose it, you'll have to purchase another one from me for a small fee.
93176.objectivesText: Use the items contained in the Entomology Starter Kit to find and catch an Arbor Tarantula, Hay Weevil Specimen, and a Flesh Picker.
93176.title: My Little Friends

93225.description:
I have noticed that centaur from different clans sometimes gather away from settlements and engage in trade. I have observed this across numerous nights and seemingly with every clan; most importantly I have seen the currency they use: carved totems.

I believe we can turn the tides in our favor with either the Gelkis or the Magram if we deliver a heavy bundle of totems right to them. I have already begun carving some, but I doubt they will be easily fooled without a few authentic ones.
93225.objectivesText: Acquire $1oa Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Gurda Wildmane at Ghost Walker Post.
93225.title: Carved Centaur Totems

93406.description:
So you need to bring the return mail back to Mount Hyjal, eh? There's a little problem...

Y'see, someone came through here and ransacked the outgoing mail just a few days ago! Probably looking for money in the mail. Ran off into the hills somewhere north of here and never came back. Probably got torn apart by a yeti or something!

Anyway, if you wanna bring back the mail, you're gonna have to go get it first!
93406.objectivesText: Find $1oa pieces of Missing Mail in the hills north of Everlook and bring it back to Innkeeper Vizzie.
93406.title: Unfrozen Deliveries

93407.description:
We need to improve our defenses here, and we lack the resources to construct fortifications. We do, however, have all of the bounty of nature.

Search the forest for thorn bushes and bring their seeds back to me. With the power of nature, we will grow our own defenses.
93407.objectivesText: Find thorn seeds in the forests at the summit of Mount Hyjal and bring them back to Tiala Whitemane.
93407.title: A Thorn in the Paw

93422.description:
The Wild King listens through shadows older than Hyjal itself. His scouts move with purpose now, stirred by the renewed advances of both Horde and Alliance in these sacred lands. The Blackthorne Pact feels the pressure of our resistance and grows more crazed each day.

Hunt down the Blackthorne Courier and end her trail before she carries their important information back to her master.

She moves between camps. Watch her path, and strike her down. Bring what she carries back to us.
93422.objectivesText: Kill the Blackthorne Courier and confiscate her message.
93422.title: Blackthorne Blackout

93510.description:
It's a heavy thing to stand in Hyjal, where so many companions met their unnatural ends. The land itself echoes with grief. Craters filled with ash, memories too bitter to forget.

Yet you carry a spark from the Eastern Kingdoms, a warmth that defies this gloom! My childhood friend Tobin enlisted alongside me, and though I hold hope, I fear for what remains of his soul.

We'd spend afternoons skipping stones as kids across Lake Everstill in Redridge. Look for a shoreline anchor, and honor our pastime?

objectives.text: Tobin's spot on Lake Everstill visited

93510.objectivesText: Find the anchor on Lake Everstill the War Veteran remembers from childhood.
93510.title: Wake Memories

93551.description:
You went out of your way for the fading wishes of a lost soul--thank you, $n. The sight of another spirit at the lake, thinking of two friends competing to see who can throw further--it's enough to draw me to this moment. Presence clings to the strongest bond with the living.

We never did skip a rock from one side to the other... 

<The ghost gazes across the lake.>

I recall. Meet me in Mourning's Rest--the site of our last battle--next to the broken cannon near the destroyed tower on the cliff.

objectives.text: Veteran of the Third War met in Mount Hyjal

93551.objectivesText: Use the Embroidered Scabbard to meet the Veteran of the Third War in Mount Hyjal near the broken cannon in Mourning's Rest.
93551.title: Praise

93584.description:
The lands surrounding the Well of Eternity are overrun with followers of the Wild King. Many once stood beside us, bound by the same oaths, but their devotion has curdled into reckless zeal. They actively hinder our efforts to tend Nordrassil and protect the Well.

I will not pretend this is easy, nor that my hands will be clean. Still, we cannot allow them to harm our land or strike our flank when the greater incursion begins.

Thin their ranks swiftly, and may Elune forgive what necessity demands.
93584.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Blackthorne Adepts and $2oa Wild-branded Cultists.
93584.title: Cult Closure

93601.description:
If you wish to recover the woman's gift, march north into the Valley of Bones.

It was stolen. The quilboar are to blame. I saw it. With my own two eyebulbs.

They are why this garden is doomed to die.

Do not forgive them.
93601.objectivesText: Seek out a quilboar of significance at the Bristleback Retreat.
93601.title: Passing the Blame

93604.description:
Big $R heard of Razorfen Downs? <Snort.> Of course not! Big place in Barrens. Lots of thorns. Can't miss it.

Agamaggan died there. Important place for all quilboar. Now bristleback not allowed. Belong to sniffle-snorting Razorfen. Razorfen disrespect quilboar history!

Agamaggan's blood feeds the valley. Grow thorns. BIG ones. Bigger than puny elf necklace ever could!

Go to the Downs. Fetch Kog'thug blood. Stale blood from the kraul won't work. Need GOOD blood!

Give blood, get necklace, win.
93604.objectivesText: Venture to Razorfen Downs and acquire Virulent Blood of Agamaggan, then return it to Kog'thug the Brave at Bristleback Retreat in the Desolace. Kog'thug felt it worth reminding that the Blood of Agamaggan inside Razorfen Kraul would not be sufficient.
93604.title: Agamaggan's Blood

93663.description:
The draenei of the Harborage are skilled fishermen, and willing to trawl more dangerous waters than I. We occasionally trade. They give us some of their catch, and I offer some of our extra supplies.

I'd sent a goblin courier to deliver my latest shipment, but he never returned. A crocolisk likely made a meal of him.

More importantly, my business reputation is at stake. That shipment must be found, and delivered to the harborage. Please, find it if you can. Check near the waters along the road.
93663.objectivesText: Find the missing courier, and ensure Dar's shipment is delivered to the Harborage.
93663.title: Lost in Transit

93680.description:
The Alliance had an army of mages known as the Kirin Tor. While they were powerful, the demonic Burning Legion proved to be even more so. In one fell swoop, the arch demon Archimonde flattened their city like it was a child's plaything. Those who remained were reduced to merely dispossessed vagabonds.

That is, until they rebuilt Dalaran. And on the Dark Lady's very doorstep, no less!

While in their camps, search for something that can get us into the city unnoticed. I must know more.
93680.objectivesText: Acquire the Dalaran Sewer Key for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
93680.title: Key to the City

93685.description:
Can your miniscule brain comprehend the rarity of a flawless sphere of draenethyst, $r? Draenei have spent lifetimes in search of just one of these crystals, only to meet horrible fates, their purpose unfulfilled.

So you stand before Kum'isha, knowing what Kum'isha has requested and still wish to assist? Very well, $r... At any time during your travels across these lands, should you find a flawless sphere of draenethyst, return it to me and I shall reward you with riches beyond your wildest dreams.
93685.objectivesText:
Find a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere in the Blasted Lands, and bring it to Kum'isha the Collector.

Be warned, this gem is one of the rarest crystals in all of Azeroth. Any creature in these lands could be holding a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere.
93685.title: To Serve Kum'isha

93786.description:
Does your blade thirst for human blood, $n?

Some years ago, the human defectors laid claim to a small farm to the southwest across the river. With the area rich in lumber and stone, it was only a matter of time before they expanded their reach to the keep along the eastern shore known as Farholde.

Our first skirmishes would have ended in our favor if we'd had the numbers. It's time to remind them of our presence.

Disrupt their farming efforts. Take no prisoners. Send them a clear message.
93786.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Meadowsbrook Farmhands, then return to Krom'rosh with news of your success.
93786.title: A Message in Blood

93787.description:
Humans within these lands have long enjoyed the warmth, comfort and sustenance these lands provide. It's time we start denying these humans such pleasantries.

Seek out the supplies of our enemies at the farm to the southwest. Take whatever you find.

It won't bring pleasure like bloodying a blade, but slowing them buys us time to plan our next move.
93787.objectivesText: Steal $1oa Feed Satchels from the Alliance farm in Meadowsbrook then return to Krom'rosh.
93787.title: Food for the Taking

93825.description:
You wish to learn from us? The trees of Hyjal speak to us. Their bark holds life, and on it grows the moss we call Moonveil. It is soft, green, and strong with the mountain's soul. We need this moss to heal our hurt and bless roots.

Go, gentle one. Seek the old trees where the mist clings and the sun hides. Take Moonveil moss from their bark and bring it back to me. With it, we will mend what pains us.
93825.objectivesText: Gather $1oa clumps of Moonveil Moss and return to Suma Mossmane.
93825.title: Barkbound Blessings

93826.description:
The old ways are lost to Deadwood. Their claws rip the wood, their hearts burn with rage. They strike at us, and the wilds shake.

You, friend of furbolg, can help. Go to their den. Show them the wild will not bow to greed. Slay those who foul the roots, and come back when their cries fade from the trees. Bring an end to their wise, but sad, sages. They twist fel and foul vines.

Do this, and we will speak to the spirits of your name.
93826.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Deadwood Totemics and $2oa Deadwood Fel-Tenders and return to Elder Pinespeaker.
93826.title: Deal Dread to Deadwood

93827.description:
The mountain winds bring dark signs. Harpies nest high where our paws do not go. The gems they wear hold strong power. Bound with our charms, they guard us from curse and bind the spirits to our wards.

But the climb is hard, and the harpies strike with claw and storm. If you are strong like they say, go to the high crags where the wind screams. Harpy grounds are in mid land Hyjal, we see them fly above us, in the north east. Take the charms from the sky witches and bring them to me.
93827.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Enchanted Harpy Amulet and return to Thobon Sapclaw.
93827.title: Windswept Wards

93833.description:
The owls of Hyjal are more than feathers and flight. Their talons, their plumes, even the bones whisper of the wild. We use these gifts to craft talismans, charms that bind the spirits and shield our kin.

But the owls do not give freely. You must take what the mountain offers. Kill $1oa owls and bring their carcasses to me.

Yes, we ask you to return the whole body to us, as we waste nothing provided by such graceful creatures.
93833.objectivesText: Bring $1oa owl bodies to Elder Pinespeaker in Barkskin Burrow in Hyjal.
93833.title: Wicked Wisdom

93952.description:
Barkskin stand on weak roots. Deadwood claw at our land, each day their rot digs deep, sinks more. We cannot hold alone. 

Deadwood Den guards are the brunt of their strength. If you seek our trust, strike down those who foul the wood. When their Guardians fall, the rest of their tribe will weaken. We even our odds.

Bring them down, for balance, and help keep Hyjal whole.
93952.objectivesText: Defeat $1oa Deadwood Den Guardians and return to Brerufa.
93952.title: Balance Through Strength

94214.description: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Shadow Protection Potion, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94214.objectivesText: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94214.title: Craftsman's Writ: Shadow Protection Potion

94217.description: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94217.objectivesText: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94217.title: Craftsman's Writ: Lesser Troll's Blood Elixir

94254.description: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Greater Adept's Robe, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94254.objectivesText: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94254.title: Craftsman's Writ: Greater Adept's Robe

94264.description: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Shadow Oil, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94264.objectivesText: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94264.title: Craftsman's Writ: Shadow Oil

94283.description: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Goblin Land Mine, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94283.objectivesText: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94283.title: Craftsman's Writ: Goblin Land Mine

94284.description: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Catseye Ultra Goggles, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94284.objectivesText: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
94284.title: Craftsman's Writ: Catseye Ultra Goggles

94502.description:
In Westfall, outside o' Moonbrook lies Stendel's Pond. Once a pure spring, now touched by dark forces. The spirits there 'ave gone silent. 

Ye must drink the water sapta, then face the corruption that fouls the waters. Take its bracers and the last drops o' Hervdana's potion, then place 'em on the shrine. That'll call forth a spirit, cleansed and true. Speak with it, learn what ye can.

Bring me proof the deed's done, and I'll grant ye the totem.
94502.objectivesText:
Drink the Water Sapta and Cleanse the corruption at Stendel's Pond in Westfall.
Return to Norric in Loch Modan when finished.
94502.title: Call of Water

94861.areaDescription: Go with Hurley to save Curly.
94861.description:
Well, I guess that explains why Curly didn't come back for lunch break. Looks like I have to bail him out again -- typical. The way he makes me worry, I swear, I'll be gray in a year.

Come on, we'll have to save him ourselves, and it sounds like we don't have much time.
94861.objectivesText: Go with Hurley to save Curly.
94861.title: Helping Hands

94872.description:
The fierce Magram are undoubtedly winning the war of territories at the moment. While we can all be thankful the clashes haven't erupted too frequently throughout the desert, every day their village just to the east grows a little bigger; their soldiers a little bolder.

I worry gravely about the consequences of an unchecked Magram clan, but I cannot deny their potential as an ally.

If you wish to earn their trust, offer this sack of totems to their quartermaster, but be careful.
94872.objectivesText: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.
94872.title: Buying Friendship: Magram

94873.description:
Either dominant centaur clan is likely to pose a good ally, but I ought to offer a word of caution regarding the Gelkis.

I have trustworthy intel that suggests, between the Magram and the Gelkis, the latter are very much on the losing side. This may work to our advantage--desperation may push the isolated clan into opening up to outside help.

I have prepared a tote of totems for you to take to their quartermaster, assuming they have one, in Gelkis Village. This may work in our favor.
94873.objectivesText: Bring the Totem Tote to the Gelkis Quartermaster at Gelkis Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan.  You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Gelkis Clan Centaur.
94873.title: Buying Friendship: Gelkis

94968.description:
Of the few that managed to infiltrate the cave, most have perished. It seems these Twilight have a foothold much larger than we thought. We will not stand by while these cultists continue to ravage these lands and make sacrifices of our allies. We end this now, $n.

Infiltrate this stronghold, slaughter their forces and bring me proof of their leader's demise.
94968.objectivesText: Infiltrate Krol'dok Stronghold and return to Krom'rosh with proof of their leader's demise.
94968.title: Eye of Mugg

94972.description:
With their location revealed, it is likely that within this stronghold are secrets kept well hidden from those we have encountered thus far. It would be wise for us to locate and recover any information that may be of use to our fight against these cultists.

See what you can uncover, $n. I await your return.
94972.objectivesText: Recover the Tome of Twilight from Krol'dok Stronghold.
94972.title: Tome of Twilight

94973.description: <The moulding appears to be for a key.>
94973.objectivesText: Find someone in Rog'mar who may know about the mould.
94973.title: Krol'dok Moulding

94975.description:
Our work here is not finished, $n. These cultists have inflicted unimaginable pain upon our allies and rendered these lands for their taking.

We will not tolerate these actions any longer.

To the north lies a hidden cave network, masked by the rugged terrain. Our scouts spoke of cultist movement under the veil of darkness.

Seek out this cave and find where these cultists are hiding. It's time we deliver a message they won't soon forget.
94975.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Cultist Ears from the Twilight's Hammer in Krol'dok Stronghold.
94975.title: A Token of Vengeance

95036.description:
Trevan tells me that the worgen are a major threat to the citizens of Silverpine Forest. Despite their strength and resilience they can be killed, but there is one in particular that just doesn't ever seem to stay dead due to unknown magic.

That's the one that attacked us. He is known as Old Fire-Eye and he is the biggest and meanest of their kind. To put him down, we'll need a special kind of weapon.

Speak with Trevan and he will supply you with a list of what is needed to forge such a weapon.
95036.objectivesText: Speak with Trevan Rol in the Sepulcher and bring him the materials he requires.
95036.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade

95118.description:
Murlocs, murlocs, murlocs! That's all I ever hear about; from the sailors, the fishermen, even my own kids! Everyone's on my case about 'em! They're a nuisance, I admit, but I got a port to run here!

Help a guy out, would ya? Kill a couple 'a those things and I'll make it worth your time.
95118.objectivesText: Kill 8 Murloc Oracles and 8 Murloc Warriors along the Eastwind Shore.
95118.title: Saltwater Savages

95120.description:
Sailors and swimmers beware! An especially aggressive murloc, nicknamed "Old Rot-Chum" by local fishermen, has been seen attacking rowboats and other small vessels in the waters to the south, near a collection of murloc-infested islands.

A reward is being offered by Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz in exchange for proof of the creature's demise.
95120.objectivesText: Bring proof of Old Rot-Chum's demise to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz.
95120.title: WANTED: Old Rot-Chum

95121.description:
Welcome to Fimbo's cafe on the water! Today's menu is roasted boar, and roasted fish...same as every day...

This menu needs a shake up, badly. I've had my eye on a new seafood stew recipe, but I'm gonna need some fresh meat. A few murloc eyes and some crab meat oughta do.

You can find both along the beaches nearby. Can't beat some good ol' fashioned local ingredients!
95121.objectivesText: Gather 12 Murloc Eyes and 6 pieces of Sand Crawler Meat for Fimbo Greasemitz.
95121.title: A Taste of the Sea

95141.description:
Far to the northeast beyond Stonard lies an embattled land along the eastern coast known as the Riverglades.

Many have sought to lay claim to these lands, but few have succeeded. There is one, however, whose experience battling our enemies proved enough to settle a small outpost known as Rog'mar. Through countless attacks, it still remains.

As ruthless as Krom'rosh may be, his will has served our allies greatly. If it's battle you seek, head northeast to seek out this old friend of ours.
95141.objectivesText: Report to Krom'rosh at the Rog'mar outpost in the Riverglades.
95141.title: Report to Rog'mar

95204.description: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in the Undercity would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
95204.objectivesText: Bring the Crest of Lordaeron to Oran Snakewrithe in Undercity.
95204.title: Crest of Lordaeron

95216.description:
Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.

You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!

I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.
95216.objectivesText: Collect the Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang in Ruins of Lordaeron for Theodore Griffs in Undercity.
95216.title: The New Plague

95254.description:
Calling all anglers!

I'm in the market for some crab meat. Not just the usual shreds either, I'm talking whole claw. I've seen a big one crawling around under the docks, stealing bait and cutting lines.

I'll pay a reward to anyone who brings me that thing's pincer. You'll also get a helping of the dish I whip up.

-- Fimbo Greasemitz
95254.objectivesText: Bring Trapclaw's Pincer to Fimbo Greasemitz.
95254.title: WANTED: Trapclaw

95262.description:
Can't say I've ever thought much about Alcaz. Near as I can tell, it's an abandoned outpost from the third war of little significance. Never heard nuthin' about a prison there. 

Well, there's nothing for it--we've got to get you in there and see what you can see, especially if there's a chance that the king is there.

objectives.text: Learn what became of Varian Wrynn

95262.objectivesText: Enter Alcaz Prison and learn what became of the King of Stormwind.
95262.title: The Secret Prison

95309.description:
Your orders are simple-- Go into the dungeons beneath the keep and find Commander Folkar. Free him if he lives, and learn what you can about what in the twisting nether is going on here.

There's an army waiting for you down there and you won't survive on your own. I hope you have allies... preferably strong ones.
95309.objectivesText: Enter the Alcaz Prison and find Commander Folkar.
95309.title: No Orc Left Behind

95314.description:
Before the Scourge invasion, the reclusive village of Shadowvale was known for its Whispering Elixir. Distilled from herbs found only in Tyr's Fall, the elixir was sought by apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners alike even after being banned in the city.

I've had requests from a number of buyers eager to get their hands on some elixir. Travel to the ruins of Shadowvale deep in the Whispering Forest to the west. I'm prepared to offer significant compensation if you can recover some bottles for me.
95314.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Bottles of Whispering Elixir from Shadowvale, then return to Carolai Anise in Brill.
95314.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

conditionalDescriptions.text:
Listen, demon caster. There have been some awfully noisy visitors just up the mountain. Like you, they taint the land with their foul demon magic and experimenting with piles of ash. It's high time we investigate.

By we, I mean you.

I want you to poke around and investigate their camp! See if you can bring me some notes on what your fellows have been up to. Surely with egos that large they've written something we can utilize. Perhaps they are carrying something on their person?

95317.description:
Listen, $c. There have been some awfully noisy visitors just up the mountain. They are tainting the land with their foul demon magic and experimenting with piles of ash. It's high time we investigate.

By we, I mean you.

I want you to poke around and investigate their camp! See if you can bring me some notes on what our mysterious fel 'friends' have been up to. Surely with egos that large they've written something we can utilize. Perhaps they are carrying something on their person?
95317.title: Notation, Notation, Notation

95319.description:
Listen, I know you can smell the fel blood pools behind me and I'm sure you've seen the crystals that grow out of them. These crystals have special properties from the ashes of Archimonde that rain down on this side of the hill.

Something about how they are formed makes them especially good at draining fel energies, which is a big problem for someone like me, but they can still have their uses.

I want you to gather some for me. Try and get a few kinds. I'll know what I need when I see it.
95319.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Fel-Slime Crystals and $2oa Pristine Fel-Slime Crystal.
95319.title: Crystalline Collection

95378.description:
It is time to cut off the heads of this hydra, if you catch my meaning.

There are three leaders who need to be killed in order to slow the operations here. Conveniently, they also need to be slain to remove the wards on my cage.

Tyaeha can be found in the House of Diseases by the creepy tree. Dazka is in the Alchemist ward with all the potions, and that fool Frezzlie is undoubtedly next to the slime pits along the northern ridge of the encampment.

Go slay them and bring me their bones!
95378.objectivesText: Retrieve the bones of Frezzlie Popwhiz, Tyaeha Darkoath and Dazka Shadowsleep.
95378.title: The Hydra's Head

95379.description:
Brashann Grimdark, Master of Vessels.

<Felflick's mouth curls into a snarl.>

He was the one to subjugate me at the summit. HE is the reason I am here in the first place.

His work with these fel-ash crystals are the backbone of this operation. He's been obsessively experimenting with anchoring souls in these crystals and his work has not gone unnoticed by those Blackthorne creeps.

Use this pristine crystal to drain his power, then put an end to him and bring me his soulstone.
95379.objectivesText: Slay Brashann Grimdark and search his body for his soulstone.
95379.title: A Revenge So Sweet

95380.description:
Listen here, $c. It seems we're in quite the sticky situation. I knew those blasted demon casters were up to no good, but this is far worse than I had expected.

Good thing I have an idea!

For this to work I will need fel-slime from the surrounding slime creatures that can be found in the fel blood pools behind me. Not the bones or bits, just the slime! Make sure you wipe your hands after handling it. It seems to be corrosive.

Not to fear, I'm sure you'll find a way to bring it back to me.
95380.title: A Prolific Source

95454.description:
My good axe arm is broken and most of my elites are dead. The honor of the Kor'kron rests with you now.

We were sent here to extract a prisoner, but not just any prisoner... We are here for the King of Stormwind, Varian Wrynn. We intercepted information that he was being held here and our Warchief commanded us to bring him back to Orgrimmar alive. The presence of black dragons... complicates things.

I need you to press on and find Wrynn. I will wait for you here while you search for him.

objectives.text: Read the note on the ground

95454.objectivesText: Look for King Varian Wrynn in Alcaz Prison.
95454.title: The Honor of the Kor'kron

95483.description:
Thrall needs to know what happened here. I will meet up with Ulka and see to it that he is fit to travel before returning to Orgrimmar, so I am trusting you to bring this information to the warchief in my stead.

Go now, soldier of the Horde. Tell our warchief what fate befell Varian Wrynn.
95483.objectivesText: Bring word of Varian Wrynn's fate to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
95483.title: Thrall Needs to Know

95494.description:
I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep.

The big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.
95494.objectivesText: Collect 6 Savannah Lion Hides from the Savannah Matriarchs and Savannah Patriarchs in the Barrens.
95494.title: Bruised Pride and Lion Hides

95534.description:
<The note is singed in places, but is still readable.>

Rumor has it those old bellows have a mind of their own, springing to life when no one is watching. I don't care if it's a ghost story, you'd better get to the bottom of it before I return.

There's great power in Strahnbrad, I know it.

< The rest of the note is singed and torn, as if burnt by fire magic. >

objectives.text: Discover the fiery mystery of Strahnbrad

95534.objectivesText: Solve the mystery of Strahnbrad and report your findings in town in Hillsbrad.
95534.title: Strahnbrad Mystery

95555.description: <A sickly energy emanates from the staff, wholly warping the natural flow of magic around you. Despite the disturbance, you cannot seem to put it down. Distantly, you notice a similar, equally foul energy resonating, drawing you in. Perhaps you can find the source of this cursed item.>
95555.objectivesText: Find the source of corruption from the staff in Feralas.
95555.title: Corrupted Nature

95568.description:
You have arrived on Mount Hyjal at a time of changes, stranger.

You may have seen that the landscape is scarred by the old war and tainted by fel energies. For Hyjal to survive, nature must bloom again.

If you are willing to help me gather seeds from some of the untainted plants, I would be grateful. Many flowers grow in the wild lands east of here. Look for small red or yellow flowers.
95568.title: Seeds for a New Season

95569.description:
The owls are under threat by the fel corruption that afflicts the mountainside, and the creatures poisoned and enraged by those energies. Many owls have abandoned their nests for safer places higher up the mountain. Others have fallen in defense of their young.

For the owls to have a future, their eggs must be protected and their fledglings nurtured. Bring the abandoned eggs to me. You may find eggs in abandoned nests at the base of trees north and east of here.
95569.objectivesText: Rescue $1oa Hyjal Owl Eggs and bring them to Ketharas.
95569.title: Hope for Hatchlings

95664.description: This unusual composite shard scatters light like a living prism. Its nature is uncertain, but its power feels ancient. The most knowledgeable minds for artifacts of this bygone age must reside on the Elder rise in Thunder Bluff.
95664.objectivesText: Take the Titan Relic to the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff and look for someone who can tell you more about it.
95664.title: Elder Knowledge

95682.description:
Dragonmaw. <She lets out a dry, amused scoff.>

The remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan think they've found something that could lead to them rising to their former power. In the eyes of whom... their false warchief?

Clear out their ragtag clan within the Excavation Sites so our Deathstalkers can move in undetected.

If the Dragonmaw carry anything of note upon them, return it to me--this information must stay between us and our royal command.
95682.objectivesText: Slay the Dragonmaw forces within the Excavation Site and return to the Deathstalker Agent outside with anything you recover.
95682.title: Open the Maw

95697.description:
Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking.
If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit.

Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites.

A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites.

Up for a job?
95697.objectivesText: Enter the Excavation Sites in the Wetlands and bring back Thicket Raptor Meat.
95697.title: Changing Tastes

95748.description:
This is odd. This piece of the tablet you have brought me refers to the lost city of I'lalai as if it is a massive sprawling civilization. But the ruins off of the reef are not large enough to be something of that size.

$n, to the north of the Vile Reef there is an ancient troll ruin on the hills along the coast. A tablet that contains legends of the lost troll city is within. I wish to study this legend further.

Take this hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of this tablet, then return to me.
95748.objectivesText: Use the hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of the Third Troll Legend tablet.
95748.title: The Gurubashi Legends of Old

95751.description:
The spirits have shown me a vision of heat, sun, and endless rolling dunes. A pair of lonely carved totems, overlooking the bones of a mighty beast half-buried by the sands of time. I was shown the desert hills of Tanaris, I am quite sure. 

The totems' purpose is not known to me, but there is surely a purpose for their lonely vigil. I wish for you to seek this place out and see if you can solve this mystery.
95751.objectivesText: Investigate the Odd Totems in Tanaris.
95751.title: Odd Totems

95773.description:
$C, your arrival is timely. I have just received new reports of naga activity just off of our coast. They seem to be swarming around some old troll ruins near the ocean floor.

We are already stretched thin defending from the local Bloodscalp and ogres ransacking our caravans. We cannot afford a surprise attack from the sea.

Go and slay as many as you are able, and bring me their tridents as proof of your success.
95773.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Brinescale Tridents from Brinescale Skirmishers.
95773.title: Enemies in the Water

95775.description:
What I am about to ask you is no small feat, $c, and will likely require strong allies to accomplish.

I want to know more about the ruins on the other side of the cavern the naga are guarding. If my suspicions prove correct, it could indeed be the lost city of I'lalai. The amount of lost historical knowledge at our fingertips could be unrivaled, but I am too old to venture myself.

Enter the ruins and gather etchings of any tablets you find there, then return to me.
95775.objectivesText: Use the hide and charcoal to create rubbings of the tablets found in the Drowned City.
95775.title: The Drowned City

95776.description:
You have done well to slay the naga just off of our coast, but the fact that they are in our waters in such numbers means there is yet a larger threat.

I have spoken to Kin'weelay, and he thinks these Brinescale naga are infiltrating the ruins of the Drowned City. If the naga are there, then they are up to no good and are likely searching for something.

We can't let them get their hands on anything that could compromise us here and it is time to put an end to this. Slay their leader and return to me.
95776.objectivesText: Slay Var'Taka in the Drowned City.
95776.title: The Only Good Brinescale...

95789.description:
Hey pal, you look like you can handle yourself in a fight.

Baron Revilgaz has me keep'n my ear to the ground for magical objects. Word on the street is that a sunken troll ruin has mysteriously become, eh, un-sunk, which means there are a lot of unclaimed goods, if you catch my meaning.

Problem is, it's also caught the eye of pirates! Not just any pirates, the Saltseers specifically collect magical artifacts. I need you to go into the Drowned City, clear them out and take their stolen artifacts.
95789.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Voodoo Infused Artifacts from Saltseer pirates in the Drowned City.
95789.title: Shady Saltseers

95791.description:
The Saltseer pirates have been a thorn in my side recently and knowing they're in the Drowned City makes it worse! I mean they're always bad news, but there is one captain in particular I want outta the picture. That damned Captain Dreadrise!

He and his crew are very accomplished at gathering all the magical artifacts I've been after, and I'm tired of the competition.

I want you to remove Captain Dreadrise and his Saltseer Coroners from the picture. Permanently.
95791.objectivesText: Slay 3 Saltseer Coroners and Captain Dreadrise in the Drowned City.
95791.title: The Saltseer Captain

95793.description:
Ah, a $c. I see great strength and determination in you--qualities necessary to rid these lands of evil.

The demons that walked these lands during the great battle were defeated, yet some still remain. It is important to prevent them from escaping.

The ruins to the east are dangerous. Carry your strength into their den. Destroy the unwelcome before our lands perish.
95793.title: Stemming the Demon Tide

95982.description:
Folks keep dumpin' their furry friends here like I know what I'm doin'. And then they blame me if they come back and their horse or wolf or... whatever they brought is dead or ran off. What do I look like, I'm runnin' a charity?

You look like you know your way around a trough. Mind whippin' me up some grub I can use to keep these beasties in check?

If you can't make it yourself, someone might be willin' to sell you some. And hurry! Last thing I need is a stampede of hungry animals.
95982.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Briny Seafood Stew to Jasper Geartoggle in Powderfuse Port.
95982.title: Not My Circus

95999.description:
Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep.

Beware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.
95999.objectivesText: Deliver the Broken Staff of Incinerator Gar'im to Magistrate Solomon in Lakeshire.
95999.title: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im

96063.description:
The fuel of the future's not coal, or oil, it's gas, baby! Those marshy ponds to the southwest spew it out by the ton, and I've got just the invention to put it to use--a new type of engine that runs on the stuff. The gas is a real pain to collect, though.

If you feel like making a humble contribution to the future of science and industry, why don't you help me get some of that gas? You can see it coming up from vents near the water.
96063.objectivesText: Gather 5 Marsh Gas Vials for Sleebo Fizzlespout.
96063.title: Gaseous Gold

96222.description:
While war rages throughout the region, the Maraudine centaur stand unchallenged in the Valley of Spears. I worry that they will grow callous in time and stir further unrest if the other clans continue to turn a blind eye to their presence.

Khan Hratha possesses a Maraudine Key Fragment, and I wish to have it as a negotiation tactic. Find a war horn mouthpiece from the centaur there and use it to challenge him atop the highest peak.

Bring the key to me, and I will have a proposition for you.
96222.objectivesText: Bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Umarak in the Desolace.
96222.title: Khan Hratha

96255.description: <Something wriggles ominously within the bone pile as green ooze seeps out from under the freshly added bones.>
96255.objectivesText: Slay the Awakened Fel Ash Slime.
96255.title: Amalgamated Marrow

96262.description:
I've known these hills since I was a hatchling. If there is one thing I know, it's that pinecones can solve a lot of problems.

Probably not what you expected, eh?

<The crow winks at you, conspiratorially.>

Go fetch me some; it's part of a little scheme I'm hatching. I promise you it will be worth the effort.

You should be able to find them under any healthy or living tree nearby. Stay away from those corrupted ones though, those pinecones aren't any good!
96262.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Prickly Pinecones under healthy trees.
96262.title: Prickly Pinecones

96296.description:
<The second you near the pulsing nodule it falls from the tree, exposing a weeping green sap. It seems the tree has corruption within its bark that has spread deep, but the tree is not yet dead.

Looking around it is clear it has spread to some of the surrounding trees, but not all suffer from the same level of corruption.

Perhaps it is not too late to save the infected trees nearby.

Surely the Highfeathers would be grateful if you remove as many corrupted knots as you can find.>
96296.objectivesText: Find and remove $1oa Corrupted Knots from the trees nearby.
96296.title: Fetid Corruption

96332.description:
A second wave of Naga was approaching the keep when we were falling back. I suspect that the battle is still raging inside. 

We Kor'kron play blood for blood. If you are going in there anyway, I want you to kill any Naga you see. I saw a sorceress among them as well, and you can bet that was their leader. Bring me her head.

We lost a lot of good orcs today and I won't rest easy knowing that we didn't give as good as we got.
96332.objectivesText: Enter the Alcaz Prison and slay $1oa Strashasz Soldiers, $2oa Strashaz Enchantresses, and bring the head of Tidemistress Ca'zass to Sergeant Ulka.
96332.title: A Little Payback

96334.description:
Most of the humans we fought wore blood red bandanas. I seem to recall hearing of a criminal organization operating in the Eastern Kingdoms known as 'The Defias Brotherhood' who are known for their red masks. Why they are active here in Kalimdor I don't know, but kill any that cross your path and bring their masks to Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. 

He'll be able to determine if these are in fact Defias masks.
96334.objectivesText: Enter Alcaz Prison and collect $1oa Blood Red Bandanas from the human guards there.
96334.title: Blood Red Bandanas

96335.description:
Wow! That was impressive. The way you took down that dragon was really something!

While you are here... do you think you might be able to help me get out of this ball and chain?

If he hasn't fled or been killed already, the torturer they call 'The Questioner' should have the keys to these shackles. Get the key from that sadist and bring it to me.

I promise that I'll make it well worth your while if you do.
96335.objectivesText: Recover the Alcaz Shackle Key from The Questioner in Alcaz Prison.
96335.title: The Man in the Iron Chains

96337.description:
I told you that I'd make it worth your while to free me. I don't have any gold for you, but I have something better.

Take this. It will help you find a treasure more valuable than gold. Do what you want with it, but if anyone asks you where you got it, tell them that the person who gave it to you died. 

Tell them he was vaporized by dragonfire... blown out to sea.
96337.objectivesText: Use the note provided by Mason Connery to find his hidden treasure.
96337.title: More Valuable Than Gold

96529.description:
Your help has been key to our scouting efforts. Take this information to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.

Remember, you're not to speak of our activities here, my presence, or SI:7 involvement to anyone else. I have a lot to continue setting up here, and plans to keep on track. 

We'll be in touch.
96529.objectivesText: Bring the Blackthorne Information to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind.
96529.title: A Shaw Deal

96603.description:
Archmage Rhonin is presently abroad investigating a disturbance in the flow of magic across Azeroth. The Archmage has charged me with soliciting the aid of strong adventurers like yourself in gathering important field data to aid him.

Take this Arcane Censer. While afflicted by its magic, you will be able to extract motes of unstable magic from the most skilled spell casters and other singularly powerful entities you may encounter. Bring me said motes and the Kirin Tor will be in your debt.
96603.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Motes of Unstable Magic to Archmage Celindra in Dalaran.
96603.title: Unstable Magic

conditionalDescriptions.text:
<Ortak looks alarmed as you approach but calms as it becomes clear you aren't Scourge.>

You...you are not Scourge? But you are undead? How is this possible...?

Well, stranger, if you are offering to aid us here I will not turn you away. We have been trapped here since the end of the war. With the Scourge remnants to the east we have been subject to constant raids and many have fallen victim to their corruption.

I would ask a favor of you, if you are willing. In the valley north of here grows an herb with blue flowers that can alleviate the pains of the infection. Gather some and bring it to me so I may help the wounded.

96616.description:
Could this be? Travelers have returned to Hyjal!

I can hardly believe it! Perhaps with your aid we will finally be freed of this place. With the Scourge remnants to the east we have been subject to constant raids and many have fallen victim to their corruption.

Please, $c. I would ask a favor of you. In the valley north of here grows an herb with blue flowers that can alleviate the pains of the infection. Gather some and bring it to me so I may help the wounded.
96616.title: Herbs for the Bruised and Weary

96658.description:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Learn cooking from William Pickman in Brill

96658.objectivesText: Speak with William Pickman in Brill to learn to become a cook.
96658.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96772.description:
Timear and I have been scrying the area on Kalimdor known as Alcaz Island and we've all but confirmed the presence of a powerful magic user there. The mage in question was able to dispel our probes, but before she did, I was able to glean an image of a tome of some sort. I believe it was a journal, written in ancient draconic script.

I don't know what is in that book, but I'd like to study it. We want you to travel to the hidden prison beneath Alcaz Island and recover that book for us.
96772.objectivesText: Recover Zarla's Journal from the depths of Alcaz Prison.
96772.title: The Dragon's Journal

96774.description:
The ancient Gurubashi of Stranglethorn Vale were da masters of dark blood magics. Rumors be they'd use pure truesilver idols to channel that bad bad voodoo.

Ol' Mazu'kon would love to get his hands on one of those idols... for academics ya see. How 'bout you gather some friends and do a bit of smash and grab on that drowned city stickin' out the ocean off the coast of Stranglethorn? Kill the most impressive lookin' priest ya can find in there, and they sure to have what I be lookin' for.
96774.objectivesText: Recover an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.
96774.title: Ancient Gurubashi Idol

96776.description:
I have had a vision.

Deep in the place known as Maraudon, past the earth song falls, there is a chamber filled with brilliant white crystals and guarded by mighty giants. At the highest part of this chamber is a crystal of exceptional brilliance. It is an aspect of the sun god, the right eye of the Earthmother herself--An'she.

I've dreamed of its radiance and it calls to me. $c, remove An'she's Radiance from that place and bring it here where it belongs, under the open skies of Mulgore.
96776.objectivesText: Recover the crystal known as An'she's Radiance from Maraudon.
96776.title: An'she's Radiance

96797.description:
We often try to find surviving family for many of our charges, and occasionally we find something hopeful. I've received word that Randal here may have a surviving family member. The man's name is Danneth, and he is a soldier stationed at Nethergarde Keep. I need someone to travel there and find the man.

If you can, please convince Danneth to come retrieve his nephew. I don't think the two have ever met, but they are family all the same and Randal belongs with him.
96797.objectivesText: Travel to Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands and locate Sergeant Danneth.
96797.title: The Orphan

96798.description:
Sergeant Danneth was last seen on patrol with his squad near Serpent's Coil, just south of Nethergarde Keep. One of the members of his squad stumbled back into the keep, badly wounded and claiming that the entire squad was killed or captured. That soldier died a few hours later, unfortunately.

We don't have confirmation that Danneth is dead, but chances aren't good. I can't spare the men to push into the cult's lair, but if you wanted to go and look for the man, I'd not refuse the aid.
96798.objectivesText: Find Sergeant Danneth somewhere in the Serpent's Coil caverns southeast of Nethergarde Keep.
96798.title: Into the Darkness

96811.description: I think I'm ready now. Let's get going when you are ready.
96811.objectivesText: Escort Sergeant Danneth out of the Serpent's Coil caves and back to Nethergarde Keep.
96811.title: Escaping the Shadows

96897.description: The Scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.
96897.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Dark Neophytes and $2oa Dark Enforcers in Tirisfal Glades.
96897.title: The Cult of the Damned

96898.description:
It wasn't long ago that the citadel of Naxxramas bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the Forsaken off the map. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the Forsaken.

During the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal mounted atop Naxxramas was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the Scourge of them.
96898.objectivesText: Gather $1oa Necrotic Crystal Fragments in Tirisfal Glades.
96898.title: Remnants of War

96957.description:
Listen, mortal. Though it may not appear a glorious job, those that are under my wing help keep the natural balance. We return many essential nutrients to the soil, allowing for new life.

These undead have disrupted the cycle here and have driven off those that seek shelter under my wings. While you are out there being the little murderous creature you are, would you collect some bones for me?

I would like to rebuild the nests of my children and followers so we may feast when this blight has ended.
96957.title: Bone Sweet Bone

96971.description:
Say, while you're out and about prancing in my lands, would you mind doing me a favor?

Once the war had been won, many of the various armies up and left. For whatever reason, they decided some of their supplies were not worth taking. That, or they all died. Who could say?

Regardless, these supplies are of use to my kits and me. Unfortunately they also tend to be where the demons are. Take this tuft of fur with you and use it on the demons to distract them while you grab the tools.
96971.title: To Outfox a Demon

96984.description:
You may not have our best interests at heart, but I won't deny an extra pair of hands. And if Dalaran falls, it takes everything with it--including your Undercity.

So, your benefactor wants in? Fine. I'll imbue your key to work past my wards so you can enter the city. Once you're in, meet me at the Violet Citadel where this all began. With everything going on the Kirin Tor will be too busy to stop you.

Scavenge what you will, but whatever happens, our first priority is to prevent a catastrophe.
96984.objectivesText: Collect the Arcane Mote in the City of Dalaran for Magus Wordeen Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
96984.title: Heart of Disruption

96986.description:
Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.

I care not for the fate of the mage city, $n, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.
96986.objectivesText: Defeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of Dalaran for Melisara in Tarren Mill.
96986.title: The Grave Knight

96987.description:
Well if it ain't a like-minded entrepreneur. Sneakin' into Dalaran durin' such troublesome times? Tsk tsk.

My kinda $r!

While our mage friends here are occupied, maybe we could find ourselves some 'misplaced' treasures. They gots whole libraries dedicated to fancy arcane magics. If you could bring me one of their secret tomes, I could sell it for a pretty penny. Split the profits with ya.

Hey hey don't look at me like that. You ain't exactly here on a field trip yourself. You want in or what?
96987.objectivesText: Collect the Founding of Dalaran from the City of Dalaran for Rexxie Copperclutch near the sewer entrance.
96987.title: Opportunistic Education

96988.description:
With the city of Dalaran under siege by their own constructs, this is the perfect opportunity to, let's say, borrow a few samples.

Imagine an army of arcane-powered abominations. The Dark Lady would have no choice but to recognize my alchemical prowess. Maybe even grant me head of the Royal Apothecary Society?

Go to the city and find the constructs' cores. They are unlikely to give them willingly, so do what you must.
96988.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Cracked Sentry Cores in the City of Dalaran for Doctor Martin Felben in Undercity.
96988.title: Source of Power

96991.description:
The climb grows steeper from here, as you say. Even an empty pack weighs on tired legs. I would ask another kindness of you, traveler. Take my excess gear and carry it ahead to the Summit, where Marn Euhron aids in restoring a foothold near Nordrassil.

I will follow at my own pace when my ceremonies here are complete. When I arrive, I will reclaim them from him and assist him in their work. This way, we both honor the journey and gifts of the mountain.
96991.objectivesText: Deliver Galvinquam's Belongings to Marn Euhron in the Summit.
96991.title: Trail Assist

97001.description:
Inside the wardrobe, a ledger records trades of hay, lumber, draft animals, and land. Other notes--personal and unfinished--are tucked between its pages.

The figures tell their own story: the Sawyer family was skilled at turning timber into weapons, tools, furniture, and wagons alike.

Thumbing through the pages reveals other kin of the family. Abigail Sawyer is listed among the relatives.

She would be very interested in this.
97001.objectivesText: Take the Sawyer Family Ledger to Abigail Sawyer in Undercity's War Quarter.
97001.title: Sawyer's Legacy

97003.description:
You there, $c. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated.

Most don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before.

Seek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone.

Blood and thunder, $c.
97003.objectivesText: Bring the head of Chol'aruk to Gur'ak in the Barrens.
97003.title: Chol'aruk the Ravener

97009.description:
Left bleeding and abandoned--thrown aside so an army could flee. I was meant to die buying them moments. 

Instead, I was cursed to endure, forced to watch ever-burning demons finish what steel could not. This is my fate.

But something is changing. Horde and Alliance return to this desecrated mountain, and war stirs again.

My fury answers it. 

If yours does as well, prove it. Bring me two handfuls of felhound spikes from these Defiling Hounds.

The pain will align our wills.
97009.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Felhound Spikes to Maerion Thaelemaches in Dae'gun.
97009.title: Maerion's Misery

97047.description:
Hey! You! You have to help me! I was just out exploring the jungle when, all of a sudden, I was ambushed by these maniacs! I don't know what they plan to do with me, but I've heard talk of tigers and headshrinkers, and I don't want part in either!

I don't know how, but you have to get me out of here! Please! A key to this cage, a disguise to sneak out, something! Anything!
97047.objectivesText: Find a key to Wendel's cage, and a disguise for him to sneak out, within the Kurzen compound.
97047.title: The Cook in the Cage

97168.description:
$n, the spirits weigh heavy, both materially and spiritually. I'm in need o' yer help. Deep within the depths of the Scholomance in Lordaeron lies the Great Ossuary, thick with shadows. I'm craftin' a device to cut that dark, but I lack the means to finish.

Bring me two diamonds: one Azerothian, and one Pristine Black. These are not trivial items, aye -- I just don't have the resources myself. Could ye provide me with the two diamonds?
97168.objectivesText: If you are interested in helping Eldrun Stormbreaker in Ironforge, bring him an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond.
97168.title: Material Assistance

97173.description:
The Blackmaw furbolgs in the mountains overlooking Azshara have been dabbling in dark magic. While a primitive people being corrupted by demonic magic is nothing new for Azeroth, Lan'dalock and I would like to study their spell foci.

Travel to the stronghold known as Blackmaw Hold and recover one of the Blackmaw Ritual Totems for us. Only the most powerful of the Blackmaw's shamans will be carrying one of these, so bring allies and take care.
97173.objectivesText: Recover a Blackmaw Ritual Totem from Blackmaw Hold.
97173.title: Blackmaw Magic

97176.description:
I have added some dirt from the tainted ground of Terrordale in the Eastern Plaguelands to the censer. Go there and use this censer to find areas with the greatest signs of corruption. You'll know these areas by the green necrotic auras that rise up from the ground at the location where tormented souls congregate.

Use the censer to reveal these spirits. Free them from their torment. When you have put these souls to rest, return and we will discuss the next steps.
97176.objectivesText: Use the Exorcism Censer to drive out the tormented spirits in Terrordale. When you have destroyed 25 Terrordale Spirits, return to Danitha Morr at Bandarion Keep in Tirisfal Glades.
97176.title: Exorcising Terrordale

97196.description:
There is a servant of the Lich King that makes his home deep in the Death's Head quilboar lair known as Razorfen Downs. It is known to us that he makes use of a scrying orb to observe and direct the movements of his minions elsewhere.

With this artifact, we'd be able to hunt down the covert agents of the Scourge and put an end to them and the threat they pose to Kalimdor forever.

Go into Razorfen Downs to the lair of Amnennar the Coldbringer and retrieve the orb known as the Coldbringer's Eye for me.
97196.objectivesText: Recover The Coldbringer's Eye from Razorfen Downs.
97196.title: The Coldbringer's Eye

97197.description:
Muln tells me that there is a location in the deepest depths of a place called Blackrock Mountain where the barrier between Azeroth and the elemental plane has been damaged, allowing a myriad of elemental creatures from the realm of the Firelands to escape into this reality, including giants as large as an Anchor Pylon!

I'd very much like to study any fragments of material that could be gathered from one of these creatures. Would you brave the Blackrock Depths and recover a sample for me?
97197.objectivesText: Recover a Fragment of the Firelands from Blackrock Depths for Alaana Stormwalker in Mulgore.
97197.title: Fragment of the Firelands

97198.description:
The Blackmaw furbolgs in the mountains overlooking Azshara have been corrupted by dark and sinister magic. We do not know the full extent of the corruption and what impact it may have upon the elements in the area, but we hope to understand it better.

Travel to the stronghold known as Blackmaw Hold and recover one of the Blackmaw Ritual Totems for us. Only the most powerful of the Blackmaw's shamans will be carrying one of these, so bring allies and prepare for a difficult battle.
97198.objectivesText: Recover a Blackmaw Ritual Totem from Blackmaw Hold.
97198.title: Blackmaw Magic

97250.description:
Traveler, have you plans to head toward Dustwallow Marsh? I have heard mutterings that a few human soldiers have taken a stand at its border and are toppling the landmarks left behind by our tauren pathfinders.

Rumor has it that a favored tavern has burned to the ground, and in typical Alliance fashion, they immediately cast their blame onto the Horde! I cannot know whether there is any truth to their claim, but their incursion onto OUR land must not stand.

Kill first, investigate later!
97250.objectivesText: Slay Alliance soldiers encroaching into the Barrens at the border to Dustwallow Marsh, then return to Grunt Logmar at Camp Taurajo.
97250.title: Wrongly Blamed, Justly Corrected

97264.description:
The Shardtooth are becoming more rabid every season. They compete with each other and the predators of the wilds for what limited food sources they can reach.

More often, they attack us, hunger driving their aggression in the bitter cold.

The bears are numerous and strong-willed. With their numbers reduced, the families that remain will grow stronger than ever.

Help them on their way. Cull the eldest of them.
97264.objectivesText: Remove $1oa Elder Shardtooth from nearby areas, then return to Sarna Brownhorn.
97264.title: Shardtooth Pulling

97265.description:
Ever strike a deal with a satyr, mon?

I have. How could I resist? The promise of power, knowledge far exceeding what any ordinary tome could offer... all alongside an eager and charismatic minion. What more could I ask for?

Bah, of course they would never bend the knee to a mortal. I bargained when I had nothing, only to be cast aside with even less.

Now, I want revenge. Revenge against the Hatefury. Raid their camp to the northeast! Stain the dirt with their foul blood.
97265.objectivesText: Defeat a variety of Hatefury satyr at Sargeron in Desolace and then return to Aka'rai in Shadowprey Village.
97265.title: Hate the Hatefury

97287.description:
You have done well to infiltrate the city of mages, but I believe it is time for us to be more... negotiatory.

As much as it pains me to admit, there is no other place on Azeroth with such a vast knowledge of the arcane. My brilliant work still pales in comparison to the ancient wisdom the Kirin Tor have amassed over the years. I think it's high time we are granted access to this exclusive order, don't you think?

Take the mote you acquired. They will surely give anything to get it back. Anything.
97287.objectivesText: Speak with the Image of Archmage Modera near Dalaran.
97287.title: Shrewd Negotiations

97288.areaDescription: Deliver the Abominable Head to someone within the Undercity.
97288.description:
<As the creature falls, its head comes toppling off. It seems as if it has been reattached several times, and the connection gets weaker with each reconnection.

Someone in the Undercity would know more about this unique abomination.>
97288.objectivesText: Deliver the Abominable Head to Master Apothecary Faranell within the Undercity.
97288.title: Unending Torment

97327.description:
It breaks my heart to admit, but my brothers and sisters inside Blackmaw Hold are irreparably corrupted.

If you bring me some of their personal belongings, I can at least give their families something to remember them by. Every bundle you recover will serve as a symbol of your service to my people.
97327.objectivesText: Enter Blackmaw Hold and recover $1oa Blackmaw Pouches for Ekkal at the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara.
97327.title: Blackmaw Pouches

97328.description:
<As you sift through the debris left behind by a horrible zeppelin crash directly above, you find evidence of a hefty shipment of supplies that has long since been plundered of all its value. Even the shipping labels have been torn and shredded, leaving only the words 'Booty Bay' barely legible on one.

Countless two-toed footprints and several patches of divotted earth all lead toward ruins in the northwest.>
97328.objectivesText: Recover $1oa Stolen Shipments from the Ruins of Zul'Kunda in Stranglethorn Vale and return your haul to someone in Booty Bay.
97328.title: Anything of Value

97329.description:
You! Yes, you! Come here, keep your voice down!

I screwed up big time. I managed to secure a sweet deal for Booty Bay to use their zeppelin tower for expedited deliveries and on our very first route I saw a huge bird--err, got SHOT DOWN just to the east of here!

I survived the crash, unfortunately, but before I woke up, I was already being dragged by my ears! Now I'm surrounded by bloodthirsty trolls and locked in a cage!

Look, I just need the key, okay? I can escape on my own.
97329.objectivesText: Bring the Primitive Key obtained from the trolls at the Ruins of Zul'kunda in Stranglethorn Vale to Zimmix Sputterspark.
97329.title: Where's the Key?

97331.description:
Wait, wait, don't go yet!

I know I said I just needed the key but... well, they caught me once, they could do it again, right? I'm just one goblin, and there's hundreds of trolls around here!

You've already put enough of a dent in their numbers to get this key, so it should be easy enough to stand guard while we mosey on out of here, huh?
97331.objectivesText: Escort Zimmix Sputterspark away from the Ruins of Zul'Kunda then tell Wharfmaster Lozgil in Booty Bay of your successful rescue.
97331.title: Zimmix's Great Escape

97332.description:
As much as I don't like the guy, I've heard what the Bloodscalp tribe do to their prisoners, and it ain't pretty. I'm glad Zimmix made it out alright.

However, I have another urgent delivery and I do NOT trust him to take it on. The problem? Nobody else will be available to take this before he does. You, however, have rescued lost cargo and a captured goblin, so you're looking pretty trustworthy from down here.

Any chance I can convince you to take this to Whizzbuzz at Powderfuse Port?
97332.objectivesText: Deliver the Twice Reordered Package to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
97332.title: Twice Misplaced Trust

97386.description:
$n! Your arrival is timely, as always.

You have provided valuable assistance to the defense of Grom'gol, and we are grateful. After your recent push against the ogres nearby, we sent out a scout to see if there are more out there that may try to enact vengeance against us. As it turns out, there is a cave far to the east that they have claimed as their hovel.

Gather a friend or two and make it very clear that we will not tolerate another threat to our settlement, now or ever!
97386.objectivesText: Commander Aggro'gosh of the Grom'gol base camp wants you to kill ogres at the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mount.
97386.title: The Offense of Grom'gol

97403.description:
These chimaeras are a cruel joke. Two tongues, both foul, snarling frost and hunger. As if this wasteland needed more teeth.

This clearing is all we have, constantly overcome by storms before we can settle further. The two-headed Chillwind Ravagers circle us, testing our resolve, bleeding our time.

We spend more hours driving them back than building anything of worth.

Cull them. Break their presence here. With fewer prowling beasts, we may yet carve something lasting from this frozen waste.
97403.objectivesText: Kill $1oa Chillwind Ravagers and return to Rilan Howard in northern Winterspring.
97403.title: Two-Headed Ravagers

97453.description:
Hi, can you help me?

My parents finally let me come along with them to this big jungle and they even let me pick a few plants just outside the gates. I'm trying to study herbalism so I can be an alchemist one day!

Anyway, I almost filled my backpack when a bunch of huge, angry weeds came out of nowhere and started spitting at me!

I ran away, and I'm fine, but now they won't let me play outside of the camp anymore. Can you make it safe for me, and then tell my mum?
97453.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Carnivorous Weeds south of Grom'gol and then inform Gemmil's mother.
97453.title: Weed Whacked

97539.description:
This encampment is being left to rot. The siege damage stands, unrepaired, as if neglect were policy. I won't permit that same decay here. The infirmary answers to me, and I intend to keep it functional.

We are nearly out of supplies. I'm going to need more equipment--enough to keep the workers and guards on their feet.

Under pressure, we can make quite an effective field suture using twisted spider silk.

$C, bring me some from the spiders that stalk these highlands.
97539.objectivesText: Return 12 Surgical Spidersilk to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall, Arathi Highlands.
97539.title: Silky Sutures

97540.description:
Oh, this fresh water smells so good... 

I'm going to stop for a moment and have a quick swim and a drink.
97540.objectivesText: Show the newly quenched Tooga the way back to his wife, Torta.
97540.title: Oasis

97894.areaDescription: Take the boat to Auberdine and find Gorbold Steelhand.
97894.description:
Pleasure to make yer acquaintance! Name's Borgus, of the one and only Steelhand family. You can always count on a Steelhand fer a fair deal!

A few weeks back me brother Gorbold joined up with a merchant stall in Auberdine. Plenty of coin to be made supplyin' ships there, let me tell you! Lucky sod.

I haven't heard from him since--mind checking on him if yer heading that way?

There's a new ship in the harbor that will take ye straight there. Head to the southern-most dock; can't miss it!
97894.objectivesText:
Check on Gorbold Steelhand in Auberdine in Darkshore.

Borgus mentioned a boat on the southern-most dock in Stormwind Harbor that can take you there.
97894.title: Business in Auberdine

97904.description:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97904.objectivesText: Speak with Lau'Tiki near Sen'jin Village to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97904.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97953.description:
Enchanters make everything better and are always welcome at any camp out in the wilds.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft an Enchanted Lute for your camp. It's so important to find entertainment during your downtime, and this bit of magic can help ensure you are ready to weather all sorts of challenges when you hit the old dusty trail once again.
97953.objectivesText: Speak with Vance Undergloom in Brill to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97953.title: Camping 101: Enchanting

97961.description:
Tailoring is a surprisingly potent tradeskill to invest in, and I'm sure it'll serve you well.

I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Faction Banner for your camp, provided you have the skill for it. Inspiration and morale are a key part of success on any battlefield, and an inspirational banner can go a long way to keeping you energized.
97961.objectivesText: Speak with Bowen Brisboise on the road to Brill from Deathknell to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.
97961.title: Camping 101: Tailoring

97985.description:
Fascinating, aren't they? This is the first time I have ever been privy to the secrets of abomination creation.

I have been studying these notes, and it appears we need a heart. A massive one!

I hear there is a thunder lizard there of impressive size called Stormheart, that patrols along the canyon edge in Thousand Needles. With a name like that it must have the perfect heart. I must have that heart!

Oh, also I suggest you bring friends. Stormheart isn't known for being docile.
97985.objectivesText: Slay Stormheart in Thousand Needles and acquire its heart.
97985.title: Thundering Hearts

98095.description:
Our high command inserts strategic troops using bat riders. Key points around the foothills have lost their signaling beacons.

Take these vials. Uncork them in three locations: the hills bordering Dun Garok, the plateau overlooking Dunholde Keep, and the last on the ridge of the Headland above the town of Hillsbrad. The vapors that emanate will be like a potent tuning rod to the senses of the bat, drawing them to the desired drop-off points once more.

Look for crushed empty vials and renew our marks.
98095.objectivesText: Deathstalker Masoj needs you to place the three Apothecary Vials on peaks around Hillsbrad Foothills and return to him.
98095.title: Valuable Vantages

98386.description:
Orcs, gnolls, murlocs. Everything seems to be out to stop me from getting this bridge done on time. Now we have word there's an infestation of tarantulas at our lumber mill!

If you're up to earn a bit more coin, would you head over to Alther's Mill to the east and clear out their spider problem? Place is as good as useless to me if I can't safely send workers to collect shipments.

Oh, and if you see ol' Alther, tell him he owes me for cleaning up his mess.
98386.objectivesText: Slay $1oa Greater Tarantulas and destroy $2oa Tarantula Eggs in Alther's Mill for Foreman Oslow in Redridge.
98386.title: Alther's Mill

98387.description:
You can't fight a war without weapons.

Though the Blackrock orcs have encroached upon these lands, their brazen efforts are not without certain vulnerabilities.

Head southeast below Stonewatch Keep, seek out their encampments, and target their weapons and supplies.

We'll see just how much of a threat they are without their tools of war.
98387.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Stolen Weapons and $2oa Blackrock Supplies to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.
98387.title: Blackrock Blockade

98477.description:
Any experienced shaman who attempts to scry the elemental plane can tell you that there is a blip of sorts, a distortion that you feel as you cross over to the other realms of existence.

We have need of adventurers like yourself to help us better understand this disturbance. Take this Elemental Attractor. You will be able to extract motes of unstable magic with it from the most skilled spellcasters and other powerful entities you may encounter. Bring me these motes so that we may study them.
98477.objectivesText: Bring $1oa Motes of Unstable Magic to Nuara Tremorhoof.
98477.title: Unstable Magic

98823.description:
Truly, this is a fascinating object.

It shows indications of being much more than a mere carving or sculpture.

While our elders may be interested in observing this artifact, the Earthen Ring are who would carry the most wisdom for our buried ruins and forgotten lands. Seek out Muln Earthfury, a direct approach is fitting for the gravity of what you carry.
