You can find him and other elders of the Earthen Ring council at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.
98823.objectivesText: Bring the Titan Relic to Muln Earthfury at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest Mulgore.
98823.title: Earthen Echo

98830.description:
The air smells sharp and metallic as you reach down to inspect the corpse of Prince Tortheldrin. Extremely powerful magic was just dispelled here.

You notice that the corpse before you looks old and weathered, lacking the vitality that the prince exuded before he fell. There are other physical differences as well.

One of Tortheldrin's glaives lies near his body, broken in two. The Shen'dralar Ancients will want to know of what you observed here.
98830.objectivesText: Deliver Tortheldrin's Broken Glaive to the Shen'dralar Ancient in Dire Maul.
98830.title: The Broken Glaive

98887.description: The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands. $B$BGo, show them the might of the Horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
98887.objectivesText: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
98887.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands

98899.description: The battle against the Darkspear Raiders is heating up. Without urgent aid, the Darkspear Islands will be lost to us. $B$BIt is your duty as a proud member of the Alliance to ensure this does not happen. Bring me proof of your contributions on the front lines and you will be revered as a hero of the Alliance!
98899.objectivesText: Bring 3 Darkspear Islands Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
98899.title: Darkspear Islands Clash

98904.description: Go forth and represent the Theramore Expeditionary Force in battle at Darkspear Islands, $n! Achieve victory and show these Horde dogs the might of the Alliance!
98904.objectivesText: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Brelinda McFarry at Northwatch Hold.
98904.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!

98906.description:
The battle at the Darkspear Islands be locked in a stalemate, $c. Show those Alliance fools who the superior force is. 

Carry your head high in service of the Darkspear and claim victory in battle. The Loa will surely be givin' you their blessing, $c!
98906.objectivesText: Win a Darkspear Islands battleground and return back to Nizook Boof at The Merchant Coast.
98906.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!

99134.description:
You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me.

As a reward for your relative lack of incompetence, you shall punish those that have demonstrated such talents in excess.

Swiftly now--$n, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.
99134.title: Discipline

99141.description:
Make no mistake, $c--the Dark Lady demands the perfect execution of her will. As an Executor, it is my duty to see that this happens.

Reports from several of my Deathguards are overdue. Needless to say, my patience has run out. Obtain their reports and bring them to me in the Dark Lady's name.

You will find Deathguard Dillinger just west of here, by the graveyard. Deathguard Kristof is stationed at the waystation to the east. And check on the abomination Gordo; he wanders west near Stillwater Pond.
99141.objectivesText: Obtain reports from Deathguard Dillinger, Deathguard Kristof, and Gordo for Executor Zygand.
99141.title: Patience

99142.description:
If you're heading east, towards the Balnir Farmstead, I have more you might do for me. Good help is ever so hard to find these days, as your run-in with Gordo illuminates ever so clearly.

As I acquire doom weed I perform some minor alchemical alterations and replant them on that farmstead to cultivate my ultimate creation. I call it tomb weed, and it shall be the herald of my glorious destiny.

Do keep an eye on the Scourge in the area while you're there. They seem... drawn... to the weed. Curious.
99142.objectivesText: Collect $1oa Tomb Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.
99142.title: Tomb Weed

99156.description:
Damn it all! A new report came in while you were on patrol. There has been a sighting of a rogue abomination wandering Eastern Tirisfal Glades, near Venomweb Vale.

Something is wrong. Abominations don't just slip through the Bulwark unnoticed.

Keep this matter on a strictly need-to-know basis. That said, such a creature will not fall easily; you will need allies if you wish to be more than its next meal.

See this through, and you will be duly rewarded. Bring me its heart as proof of the deed.
99156.objectivesText: Bring Riptear's Heart to Deathguard Linnea.
99156.title: Rear Guard Patrol

99435.description:
Windsor has already set off to confront Lady Prestor in Stormwind Keep, $c. He spoke highly of your bravery. I suggest you hurry to his aid!

He is now certain that Prestor is Onyxia: Brood of Deathwing, twin to the tyrant of the Spire, Nefarian.

According to him, even the Highlord is controlled by her trickery! The Marshal intends to break the spell and free all of Stormwind from the dark shadow of these fiends.

Find him and ensure the deed is done!
99435.objectivesText:
Follow Reginald Windsor through Stormwind. Protect him from harm!

Speak to Squire Rowe if you need to contact Reginald Windsor again.
99435.title: The Great Masquerade
